tls:text.tls:line: to practise the various observances of discipline.

sense.def: ZUO: proper behaviour; BUDDH: the proper behaviour/right demeanor; in the Buddhist context referring to the proper conduct of monks and nuns as defined in the vinaya texts and other texts related to the precepts (the origin of this term is pre-Buddhist and refers to right behaviour, proper demeanor; in the Buddhist context referring to the proper conduct of monks and nuns which is defined especially in vinaya texts and texts related to the precepts. Often the term refers to four specific deportments in daily life (sìwēiyí 四威儀), i.e. when walking, standing, sitting, and lying down (representing the daily activities). See especially DDB (see also NAKAMURA: 33b; FOGUANG: 3771; according to Yanagida yǒubiǎo 有表 'have-expression > expressed, manifest' is a term typically used in the Vinaya School, referring to the concrete correct behaviour required in performing the 'three actions' (sānyè 三業, i.e. physical actions, oral expressions and thought processes). Often set in contrast to wúbiǎo jiè 無表戒 'un-expressed (non-manifest) precepts' (see YANAGIDA 1990: 396, fn. 269; on yǒubiǎo and wúbiǎo see also DDB) corr[CH])

tls:text.tls:line: and then, after killing Kòngfù, he murdered duke Shāng.

sense.def: assassinate (a superior), whether one's ruler, parent, or elder sibling. Sometimes incirectly through a hired assassin

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.1.5 (710 B.C.); Y.85; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 58; tr. Legge 39

tls:text.tls:line: in order to please Zhèng,

sense.def: show personal close affection for, keep close to, be on close terms with; attach oneself to, develop close relations with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.1.5 (710 B.C.); Y.85; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 58; tr. Legge 39

tls:text.tls:line: bribing also the duke of Lǔ with the great tripod of Gào.

sense.def: bribe; bribe (e.g. yǐ 以 "with" precious objects, workers, or fine horses); give bribes to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: cause to enter into> conduct into;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: central ancestral temple of the state

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: "He who is a ruler of men

sense.def: the ruler (of the type in question)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: "He who is a ruler of men

sense.def: subject(s) of V generally (often generic, the verb typically untensed) sometimes with large scope: 有國有家者

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: makes it his object to illustrate his virtue, and to repress in others what is wrong,

sense.def: make widely illustrious; show off; make generally known

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: makes it his object to illustrate his virtue, and to repress in others what is wrong,

sense.def: block up (both in concrete and in abstract senses); block, hinder

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: makes it his object to illustrate his virtue, and to repress in others what is wrong,

sense.def: disobedience

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: that he may shed an enlightening influence on his officers.

sense.def: enlighten through one's charismatic virtue

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.1 (710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: that he may shed an enlightening influence on his officers.

sense.def: the various officials

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: He is still afraid lest in any way he should fail to accomplish these things;

sense.def: be afraid that S 懼有伏焉 "he was afraid there was an ambush"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: He is still afraid lest in any way he should fail to accomplish these things;

sense.def: be afraid that one might V; be afraid to; be afraid that one V-s

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: He is still afraid lest in any way he should fail to accomplish these things;

sense.def: conceivably; probably, quite possibly, in all likelihood; "before you know it"; by any chance

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: Thus it is that his ancestral temple has a roof of thatch;

sense.def: subjective motivation: for that subjective reason; that is why, thus

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: Thus it is that his ancestral temple has a roof of thatch;

sense.def: made of reed, thatched

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: the mats in his grand chariot are only of grass;

sense.def: ceremonial carriage (often used as gift)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: the grand soups are without condiments;

sense.def: spiced meat with added rice or wheat flour; another common type of gēng 羹 was simply a meat soup made thick by very long boiling

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: the millets are not finely cleaned:

sense.def: general word for grains, especially coarse grain; grain used for sacrificing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: all these are illustrations of his thrift.

sense.def: make widely illustrious; show off; make generally known

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.2(710 B.C.); Y.86; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: all these are illustrations of his thrift.

sense.def: frugality, economic use of resources

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: His robe, cap, knee-covers, and mace;

sense.def: ceremonial hat worn by the Son of Heaven, a special kind of miǎn 冕. Current in Later Han times.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: His robe, cap, knee-covers, and mace;

sense.def: hat worn by emperors and the very highest officials 冕者，冠也，大夫之服也。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: His robe, cap, knee-covers, and mace;

sense.def: embroidered patterned garments

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: His robe, cap, knee-covers, and mace;

sense.def: kind of jade

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: his girdle, lower robe, buskins, and shoes;

sense.def: specifically: inner belt; any belt or sash

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: his girdle, lower robe, buskins, and shoes;

sense.def: SHI: lower garment (particularly those worn below the yī 衣 "upper clothes" 毛傳：在下曰裳)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: his girdle, lower robe, buskins, and shoes;

sense.def: leather shoes with wooden soles (the wooden soles before post-Han times), general word for shoe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: the cross-piece of his cap, its stopper pendants, its fastening strings, and his crown;

sense.def: ribbon used in hat

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: n: double hat-string

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: all these illustrate his observance of the statutory measures.

sense.def: make widely illustrious; show off; make generally known

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.3 (710 B.C.); Y.87; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: objective standard or measure by which to judge things; standard rule (e.g. on clothing to be worn)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.4 (710 B.C.); Y.88; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.4 (710 B.C.); Y.88; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: The flames, the dragons, the axes, and the symbol of distinction represented on his robes

sense.def: patterns of all styles; decorated brocade of all sorts

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.4 (710 B.C.); Y.88; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: these illustrate the elegance of his taste,

sense.def: elevated aesthetic beauty; elegance; decorous patterning

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.4 (710 B.C.); Y.88; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: The bells on his horses' foreheads and bits, and those on his carriage pole and on his flags:

sense.def: bell on horse's forehead

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.4 (710 B.C.); Y.88; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.4 (710 B.C.); Y.88; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: The bells on his horses' foreheads and bits, and those on his carriage pole and on his flags:

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.4 (710 B.C.); Y.88; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: The bells on his horses' foreheads and bits, and those on his carriage pole and on his flags:

sense.def: very small bell with handle at top, smaller even than duó 鐸.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: thrifty and observant of the statutes,

sense.def: be too economical, be stingy with one's expenses

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: objective standard or measure by which to judge things; standard rule (e.g. on clothing to be worn)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: enlighten through one's charismatic virtue

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: they are struck with awe,

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: they are struck with awe,

sense.def: then, thereupon; at that moment

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: they are struck with awe,

sense.def: be full of wariness and fear

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: and do not dare to depart from the rules and laws.

sense.def: change fundamentally, make a fundamental change to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: and do not dare to depart from the rules and laws.

sense.def: administrative rules

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: But now you are extinguishing your virtue,

sense.def: destroy

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: and have given your support to a man altogether bad.

sense.def: disobedience

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: You have placed moreover the bribe received from him in the grand temple,

sense.def: serving as a bribe 賂器

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: You have placed moreover the bribe received from him in the grand temple,

sense.def: vessel of any kind; also: eating utensils, the plates and pots food is served or kept in

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: The ruin of States and clans

sense.def: the nation; a nation

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: The ruin of States and clans

sense.def: destruction, ruin

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: takes its rise from the corruption of the officers.

sense.def: come from, arise from; have as a basis

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: takes its rise from the corruption of the officers.

sense.def: wicked activities; heterodox practices

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.7(710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: overlook, fail to notice; fail to use; fail to take proper note of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.7(710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: when the fondness for bribes on the part of their ruler is displayed to them;

sense.def: be fond of (bribes etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.7(710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: when the fondness for bribes on the part of their ruler is displayed to them;

sense.def: bribe 受賂

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.7(710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

sense.def: be more intense than; be stronger than 甚於

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.7(710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.7(710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.7(710 B.C.); Y.89; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.2.8 (710 B.C.); Y.90; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 60; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: His prince was doing wrong,

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.5 (710 B.C.); Y.91; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 63; tr. missing

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.6 (710 B.C.); Y.91; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 63; tr. missing

tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 2.7.2 (710 B.C.); Y.91; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 63; tr. Legge 40

tls:text.tls:line: "Our lord, in fearful awe of your lord's awe-inspiring authority,

sense.def: our (lord), my (used by a member of his family) 寡君

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "Our lord, in fearful awe of your lord's awe-inspiring authority,

sense.def: you, my ruler; your lordship; you, my master

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "Our lord, in fearful awe of your lord's awe-inspiring authority,

sense.def: [cognate with wēi 威 "authority" fear and revere; stand in awe of 畏天之威

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "Our lord, in fearful awe of your lord's awe-inspiring authority,

sense.def: stand in fear of; fear, be very much afraid of and at the same time in awe of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "Our lord, in fearful awe of your lord's awe-inspiring authority,

sense.def: awe-inspiring authority; authoritarian legal restrictions

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: did not dare to rest easy

sense.def: presume; venture, have the audacity to (do something in front of a superior); make bold to; take the liberty of V-ing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: did not dare to rest easy

sense.def: (dwell) at peace

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he came here to renew good diplomatic relations.

sense.def: cultivate (one's person, the ancients etc); apply oneself to; train and exercise (troops); occasionally also with negative objects: LH 2 修詐 "cultivate fraudulence"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he came here to renew good diplomatic relations.

sense.def: former; sometimes pejorative: of non-recent origin; past-and-gone; outdated; deposed previous (incumbent of office)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he came here to renew good diplomatic relations.

sense.def: good diplomatic relations; acts of friendship

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: But once the rituals were completed, he did not return.

sense.def: (a concrete) ritual (of this or that kind)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: But once the rituals were completed, he did not return.

sense.def: have come to completion, have been brought to completion

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: But once the rituals were completed, he did not return.

sense.def: return, get back to where one came from; make one's return; flee back

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: There is no place to lay the blame for this,

sense.def: attribute (something N2) to a contextually determinate person N1

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: There is no place to lay the blame for this,

sense.def: moral blame; recriminations

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: but it causes us to be resented by the feudal feudal lords.

sense.def: cause to be hated by

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: We request you do away with Péng Shēng."

sense.def: suggest (as an inferior) that one should V, beg to V; ask permission (to do something one is offering to do in serving one's superiors);

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: We request you do away with Péng Shēng."

sense.def: object marker: 把(這個東西) also: 以。。。而。。。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.1.4 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 152; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 107; tr. Watson 1989:18; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: We request you do away with Péng Shēng."

sense.def: abolish; get rid of, weed out; remove; make clean, clear (a road); dismiss from office; have (someone) removed

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.1 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: the marquis of Qí went with a force to Shǒuzhǐ,

sense.def: deploy one's troops for aggressive purposes at, encamp at

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.1 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: Gāo Qúmí being in attendance as his minister.

sense.def: serve as prime minister

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.1 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: and caused Gāo Qúmí to be torn in pieces by chariots.

sense.def: tear apart between carts

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.2 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: After this Jì Zhòng sent to Chén for another son of duke Zhuāng, met him,

sense.def: welcome; go out to welcome (a bride etc); go out to meet as a gesture of politeness or submission

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.2 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: and made him earl of Zhèng.

sense.def: instate, establish formally in a position (as ruler or official)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.2 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: made a pretence of being ill, and would not accompagny them.

sense.def: adduce as a pretext 稱病

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.2 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: made a pretence of being ill, and would not accompagny them.

sense.def: go to the contextually determinate place (often answering a summoning by a superior)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.2 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: "Jì Zhòng escaped by his intelligence,"

sense.def: avoid the worst; go free of punishment, go scot free; go free of misfortune; escape menial labour; escape (from trouble)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.2.2 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 153; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: that it was so.

sense.def: be reliably true, be trustworthy; be certainly the case

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.3.1 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 154; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: The duke of Zhōu wished to murder king Zhuāng,

sense.def: assassinate (a superior), whether one's ruler, parent, or elder sibling. Sometimes incirectly through a hired assassin

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.3.1 (694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 154; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: and then he and the king put the duke of Zhōu, HēiJiān, to death,

sense.def: with (subject omitted immediately in front of yǔ 與)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.3.2(694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 154; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: Zǐ Yí was the favourite with king Huán,

sense.def: enjoy favour with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Huan 18.3.2(694 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 154; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 109; tr. Legge 71

tls:text.tls:line: who placed him under the care of the duke of Zhōu.

sense.def: consign (N1) to (N2), leave to, entrust to屬輕重於權衡

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 1.1 (693 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 111; tr. Legge 73

tls:text.tls:line: The phrase "jí lì" is not used here

sense.def: 1. with quasi-indirect speech vt: declare, say that; with direct speech quotation, vt: quote, bring up the saying: "..."; say:...

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 1.1 (693 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 111; tr. Legge 73

tls:text.tls:line: The phrase "jí lì" is not used here

sense.def: ascend the throne

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 1.3 (693 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 111; tr. Legge 73

sense.def: build with earth [SHI]; build from scratch, erect

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 1.3 (693 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 111; tr. Legge 73

sense.def: high-level guest house for ordinary official visitors; a fairly well-appointed dwelling

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 2.1 (692 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 112

sense.def: write the contextually determinate thing down; make a written record of a contextually determinate event

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 3.2 (691 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 161; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 112

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 3.3 (691 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 161; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 112; tr. Legge 75

tls:text.tls:line: Jǐ now began to be divided.

sense.def: N then V-ed; N thus V-ed

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 3.4 (691 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 161; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 112; tr. Legge 76

sense.def: make a halt in; spend some days in

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 3.4 (691 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 161; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 112; tr. Legge 76

tls:text.tls:line: In all military expeditions,

sense.def: military campaign

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 3.4 (691 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 161; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 112; tr. Legge 76

tls:text.tls:line: where a halt is made for one night, it is called shè.

sense.def: a night

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 3.4 (691 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 161; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 112; tr. Legge 76

tls:text.tls:line: where it is for two nights, it is called xín;

sense.def: twice 再拜

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.1 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 163; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and being about to fast before the delivery of the new weapons,

sense.def: to fast

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.2 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 163; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: said she, sighing, " is near an end.

sense.def: life

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.2 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 163; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: such is the way of Heaven.

sense.def: way of heaven>law of nature

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: The former rulers must know this;

sense.def: (our/my) former rulers

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and therefore, at the commencement of this military undertaking,

sense.def: military; martial; military-minded

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: they have thus agitated your majesty's heart.

sense.def: shake, rock (a boat)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: If the expedition take no damage,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and your majesty die on the march,

sense.def: journey, a trip, an expedition

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: it will be the happiness of the State."

sense.def: good fortune and happiness (also in the form of wealth...); blessings

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and died under a mán tree.

sense.def: die (of Duke Wen of Jin, or of prince, sage etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.3 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and died under a mán tree.

sense.def: below

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.4 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: made a new path bridged over the Zhā

sense.def: serve as bridge over; to bridge

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.4 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and led their army close to Suí,

sense.def: lead

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.4 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and led their army close to Suí,

sense.def: from Qin times onwards: regular army; overall armed forces (could consist of up to a million men) 一軍

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.4 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: the inhabitants of which were afraid,

sense.def: become frightened; become scared

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.4 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: the inhabitants of which were afraid,

sense.def: be fearful; be scared;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.4 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: and asked for terms of peace.

sense.def: sue for peace; make peace

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.5 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: after which the army returned.

sense.def: make an about turn and withdraw, turn back, head back; turn round in order to withdraw or return to where one comes from, or retrace one's steps

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.1.5 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 164; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: It was not till it had crossed the Hàn

sense.def: go across, try to get across; traverse, succeed to get across

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.2 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 165; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: The marquis of Jǐ was unable to submit to Qí,

sense.def: surrender to, submit to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 4.2 (690 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 165; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 113; tr. Legge 77

tls:text.tls:line: In summer,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 6.1.2 (688 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 168; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 115; tr. Legge 79

tls:text.tls:line: In summer,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 6.1.2 (688 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 168; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 115; tr. Legge 79

tls:text.tls:line: After this he took his place as marquis.

sense.def: and thereupon, and then accordingly; then without delay;Then accordingly (often after a direct speech)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 君子以二公子之立黔牟為不度矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 6.1.3 (688 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 168; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 115; tr. Legge 79

tls:text.tls:line: The superior man will say, "The action of the two sons of duke Hwan in raising K'een-mow to the marquisate was ill considered.

sense.def: a person of superior character; the person of superior character 得見君子者斯可矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 6.1.3 (688 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 168; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 115; tr. Legge 79

tls:text.tls:line: He who would be able to make sure the seat to which he raises any one,

sense.def: subject(s) of V generally (often generic, the verb typically untensed) sometimes with large scope: 有國有家者

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 6.1.3 (688 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 168; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 115; tr. Legge 79

tls:text.tls:line: must measure the beginning and the end of his protege,

sense.def: be rudely negligent, negligently supercilious, be self-indulgently informal

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:text.tls:line: A rebellion will break out."

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 9.1 (685 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 179; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 123; tr. Watson 1989:20; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Yōng Lǐn killed Wúzhī.

sense.def: 不免有殺身之禍have (someone/onself) killed; cause someone/oneself to lose his life, The general word, to be used about animals as well as humans (and occasionally about plants as well), for whatever cause or reason and with whatever means; (sometimes the killed person comes to life again as in ZUO 7.8.1.1)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 9.2 (685 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 179; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 123

sense.def: 衛人及狄盟 N2 V-s, in conjunction/cooperation/interaction with N1 (In the following the first designates joint action, the second interaction: 叔孫豹及諸侯之大夫及陳袁僑盟。 公及楚公子嬰齊、蔡侯、許男、秦右大夫說、宋華元、陳公孫寧、衛孫良夫、鄭公子去疾及齊國之大夫盟于蜀。)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Huán had been beforehand in entering Qí from Jiū.

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: be utterly defeated, suffer a severe defeat; be ruined (of a state)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: carriage

sense.def: for this objective reason

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 9.4 (685 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 179; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 123; tr. Legge i4

tls:text.tls:line: and the consequence was that they were both taken.

sense.def: get detained; be taken prisoner; get captured

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: relative

tls:text.tls:line: Guǎn and Shào are his enemies;

sense.def: arch enemy, foe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 9.5.1(685 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 180; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 123; tr. Legge i4

tls:text.tls:line: On this we killed Zījiū in Shēngdòu,

sense.def: and thereupon, and then accordingly; then without delay;Then accordingly (often after a direct speech)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 9.5.1(685 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 180; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 123; tr. Legge i4

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 9.5.2 (685 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 180; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 123; tr. Legge i4

tls:text.tls:line: If you employ him as your chief minister and helper, it will be well."

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 9.5.2 (685 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 180; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 123; tr. Legge i4

tls:text.tls:line: If you employ him as your chief minister and helper, it will be well."

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.1(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: aiming for meat, having meat as an object

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.1(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: interfere with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.1(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "The flesh-eaters are poor creatures,

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.1(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "The flesh-eaters are poor creatures,

sense.def: feed regularly on N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.2 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: So he entered and was introduced,

sense.def: and thereupon, and then accordingly; then without delay;Then accordingly (often after a direct speech)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.2 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: go in to have an audience with N

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.2 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: ask and say (: "...", with direct object without yuē 曰)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.2 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: but I do not dare to monopolise them:

sense.def: control and determine alone; monopolise

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.2 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: I make it a point to share it with others."

sense.def: distribute things to people; share things with people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.3(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "That," answered Guì,"is but a small kindness, and does not reach to all.

sense.def: reach everywhere; reach everyone

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.3(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: The people will not follow you for that."

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.3(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In the victims, the gems, and the silks, used in sacrifice,

sense.def: sacrificial beasts (typically but not always ox, sometimes also sheep)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.3(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In the victims, the gems, and the silks, used in sacrifice,

sense.def: jade

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.3(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In the victims, the gems, and the silks, used in sacrifice,

sense.def: silk cloth; silken clothes

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.3(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: I make it a point to be sincere."

sense.def: use as a standard of behaviour

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.4 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "This is but small sincerity; it is not perfect:

sense.def: obedienct service (to the gods or superiors)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.4 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: the Spirits will not bless you for that."

sense.def: cause to be fortunate

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.4 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In all matters of legal process, whether small or great,

sense.def: litigation; criminal law case; trial; criminal procedure 獄決罪定

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.4 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: I make it a point to decide according to the real circumstances."

sense.def: real facts of a matter, real state of affairs; real facts of a case

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.4 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "bespeaks a lealheartedness:

sense.def: what belongs to a certain category; the likes of 有血氣之屬

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.5 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: The duke took him with him in his chariot.

sense.def: with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.5 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: The duke took him with him in his chariot.

sense.def: ride a carriage

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.5 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: The duke was about to order the drums to beat an advance,

sense.def: beat the drum to send (soldiers) into an attack

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.5 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: and after the men of Qí had advanced three times with their drums beating,

sense.def: three times

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.5 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: and after the men of Qí had advanced three times with their drums beating,

sense.def: beat the drums to attack (the enemy); attack

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.6 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: The army of Qí received a severe defeat;

sense.def: be utterly defeated, suffer a severe defeat; be ruined (of a state)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.6 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: but when the duke was about to dash after them,

sense.def: race after, pursue

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.6 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: and examined the tracks left by their chariot-wheels,

sense.def: rut

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.6 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: remounted, got on the front-bar, and looked after the flying enemy.

sense.def: horizontal cross-bar on a cart or chariot

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.6 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: remounted, got on the front-bar, and looked after the flying enemy.

sense.def: look out for; look at (admiringly) from afar; look to (for guidance); look into the distance (as from a tower etc); see from a distance; look around; look into distance in expectation of somebody's arrival

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.6 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.6 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: the duke asked Guì the reasons of what he had done.

sense.def: to ask for relevant information about 問其故, 問他

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In fighting," was the reply,"all depends on the courageous spirit.

sense.def: "Now,", "In fact," introducing new subject for the discourse, and introducing non-narrative theoretical discourse.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In fighting," was the reply,"all depends on the courageous spirit.

sense.def: the energy that comes from courage

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In fighting," was the reply,"all depends on the courageous spirit.

sense.def: inner mental energies of a person; vital energies in a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: "In fighting," was the reply,"all depends on the courageous spirit.

sense.def: fighting spirit

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: When the drums first beat, that excites the spirit.

sense.def: beat the drum for an attack

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: When the drums first beat, that excites the spirit.

sense.def: inner mental energies of a person; vital energies in a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: for a second time

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: With our spirit at the highest pitch we fell on them with their spirit exhausted;

sense.def: other people; the other party

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: we, our party; we for our part

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

tls:text.tls:line: But it is difficult to fathom a great State;

sense.def: "Now,", "In fact," introducing new subject for the discourse, and introducing non-narrative theoretical discourse.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: fathomable 不測"unfathomable"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.1.7 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 125; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: pursue; chase; hunt after; hunt for (also abstractly: wisdom); engage in a private hunt of

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.2.1(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 128; tr. Legge 86

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.2.1(6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 128; tr. Legge 86

sense.def: then, thereupon; sometimes after direct spech: then accordingly

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.2.2 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 128; tr. Legge 86

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.3.1 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 128; tr. Legge 87

tls:line.loc: ZUO Zhuang 10.4.1 (6i4 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 128; tr. Legge 87

sense.def: 其夏

sense.def: be; be called; run as follows

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.2.2 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 197; tr. Legge 136

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.2.2 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 197; tr. Legge 136

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.2.3 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 197; tr. Legge 136

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.2.3 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 197; tr. Legge 136

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.2.4 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 197; tr. Legge 136

sense.def: invade, make an incursion into; invasion, incursion; sometimes generally: attack (place or persons, eg 侵我 "attacked us")

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.2.4 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 197; tr. Legge 136

sense.def: (my ruler's) humble (N)> my humble

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.2.4 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 197; tr. Legge 136

sense.def: Western Zhou inscriptions, SHU, occasionally: capital

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 2.5 (658 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 2i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 199; tr. Legge 137

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 3.1 (657 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 285; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 200; tr. Legge 138

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 3.5 (657 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 286; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 200; tr. Legge 138

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 3.5 (657 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 286; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 200; tr. Legge 138

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 3.5 (657 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 286; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 200; tr. Legge 138

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: The viscount of Chǔ sent a messenger to the allied army to say to the marquis,

sense.def: in interaction with; in association with; with; in collusion with, in cooperation with (NB: MOVE THE HOSTILE CASES TO THE HOSTILE VARIANT!)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: so remote are our boundaries that our cattle and horses, in the heat of their excitement, cannot affect one another.

sense.def: ready to copulate, on heat

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: Without my having any idea of it, your lordship has come to my country.

sense.def: expect that

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.3 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: (lit: it is you who should... CH)

sense.def: familiar, informal you

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.3 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: in order to support and help the House of Zhōu.'

sense.def: "house of" 周室 "house of Zhōu"; household; members of the household 公室

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: from the sea on the east

sense.def: reaching until> as far as, to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: to the Hé on the west,

sense.def: reaching until> as far as, to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: and from Mùlíng on the south

sense.def: reaching until> as far as, to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: to Wúdì on the north.

sense.def: reaching until> as far as, to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: Your tribute of covered cases of the three-ribbed rush is not rendered,

sense.def: give by way of tribute

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: and there is nothing with which to strain the spirits;

sense.def: to strain (wine)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: of this we have to ask you an account.

sense.def: demand (evidence, knowledge etc)???; (of states) demand, require (taxes etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: King Zhāo moreover never came back from the expedition which he undertook to the south;

sense.def: return where one comes from/belongs

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: and into this also we have to inquire."

sense.def: ask about N 每事問

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: and into this also we have to inquire."

sense.def: ask about (something or someone to be discussed) 問政

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: "That the tribute has not been forwarded

sense.def: tribute, offering

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: is the fault of our lord;

sense.def: our (lord), my (used by a member of his family) 寡君

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: is the fault of our lord;

sense.def: criminal offence, deliberate illegal act; punishable crime; grave fault

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: you should inquire about it along the banks of the river."

sense.def: to ask for relevant information about 問其故, 問他

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: you should inquire about it along the banks of the river."

sense.def: waterway; river; flood

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: you should inquire about it along the banks of the river."

sense.def: area close to the bank of a river or by the side of a lake, or the sea

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: After this the army of the allies advanced,

sense.def: move forward, step forward, come forward

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.6 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 140

tls:text.tls:line: and halted at Xíng.

sense.def: make a halt in; spend some days in

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: In summer,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: the viscount of Chǔ sent Qū Wán to the army of the allies,

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and halted at Shàolíng.

sense.def: make a halt in; spend some days in

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: The marquis of Qí had the armies of all the princes drawn up in array,

sense.def: lay out physically, display and deploy; line up

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and took Qū Wán with him in the same carriage to survey them.

sense.def: with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: "Is it on my unworthy account that these are here?

sense.def: me (the king)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: No, but in continuation of the friendship of the princes with my predecessors.

sense.def: the former ruler; the deceased ruler (can occasionally be used in the plural in ZUO)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.7 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: No, but in continuation of the friendship of the princes with my predecessors.

sense.def: continue with, carry on, continue the tradition of; succeed in the post of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.8 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and you will condescend to receive our prince,

sense.def: humiliating yourself> humbly

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.8 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: this is his wish."

sense.def: hope

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.8 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: who can withstand me?

sense.def: who? i.e. no one!

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.8 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: who can withstand me?

sense.def: ward off, hold at bay, stop, hinder

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.8 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: who can withstand me?

sense.def: me 天厭之may Heaven reject me!

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.8 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

sense.def: a walled city

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.9 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: "If your lordship," was the reply, "by your virtue, seek the tranquillity of the States,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.9 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: "If your lordship," was the reply, "by your virtue, seek the tranquillity of the States,

sense.def: to comfort; calm down

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.9 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and the Hàn for a moat.

sense.def: the River X

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.9 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and the Hàn for a moat.

sense.def: defensive moat

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.9 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: Great as your multitudes are,

sense.def: be many, be numerous; contain many members; be in the majority 甚眾

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.1.9 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 201; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: Qū Wán made a covenant, on the part of Chǔ, with the princes.

sense.def: 衛人及狄盟 N2 V-s, in conjunction/cooperation/interaction with N1 (In the following the first designates joint action, the second interaction: 叔孫豹及諸侯之大夫及陳袁僑盟。 公及楚公子嬰齊、蔡侯、許男、秦右大夫說、宋華元、陳公孫寧、衛孫良夫、鄭公子去疾及齊國之大夫盟于蜀。)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.1 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: our States will be very much distressed.

sense.def: get into trouble; suffer disaster

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.1 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: If they go by the eastern regions,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.1 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and show their grand array to the wild tribes there,

sense.def: flaunt N1 to N2; make a show of N1 to N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.1 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: returning along the sea-coast,

sense.def: follow the course of (a shore, a river etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: "The army has been in the field a long time.

sense.def: occasionally, in derived sense: exhausted from long fighting effort

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: If it march through the eastern regions, and meet with enemies,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: If it march through the eastern regions, and meet with enemies,

sense.def: encounter (a tiger etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: I fear the soldiers will not be fit for use.

sense.def: be afraid that S 懼有伏焉 "he was afraid there was an ambush"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.2 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: If it march through the Chén and Zhèng,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.2.3 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and gave Shēn the town of Hǔláo,

sense.def: hand over (something N2) to (someone N1), typically as demanded; give (as appropriate under the circumstances, but without having to)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.3 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: This was done to punish Chén for its unfaithfulness.

sense.def: punish 討罪

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.3 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: This was done to punish Chén for its unfaithfulness.

sense.def: disloyalty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Mù of Xǔ died in the army,

sense.def: die (of Duke Wen of Jin, or of prince, sage etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and was buried with the ceremonies due to a marquis.

sense.def: 葬之以侯 "bury him as if he were a marquis" (V someone) as an N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and was buried with the ceremonies due to a marquis.

sense.def: as in 齊侯 "marquis of Qi2" (Note incidentally: there never was any Duke of Qi2): marquis (The descending hierarchical order was 公侯伯子男.)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: As a rule, when a prince died on a visit to the king,

sense.def: a feudal lord; occasionally also count noun: feudal lord, as in SHIJI: 漢王部五諸侯兵 "the king of Han lead the armed forces of five feudal lords"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: As a rule, when a prince died on a visit to the king,

sense.def: of senior officials: die [occasionally also used to refer to the death of an emperor]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: If he died while engaged in the king's business,

sense.def: die in the course of (tasks for/service for the king etc); dies as a result of/in the process of (political disorder)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: On this occasion, Mù might have been laid in his coffin with a duke's robe.

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: On this occasion, Mù might have been laid in his coffin with a duke's robe.

sense.def: duke's robe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.4 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 205; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: On this occasion, Mù might have been laid in his coffin with a duke's robe.

sense.def: bury the contextually determinate N1 V-ing the N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 206; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and joined the forces of the other princes in an incursion into Chén,

sense.def: invade, make an incursion into; invasion, incursion; sometimes generally: attack (place or persons, eg 侵我 "attacked us")

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 206; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: which now sought peace,

sense.def: make peace, offer peace; sue for peace

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.5 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 206; tr. Legge 141

tls:text.tls:line: and Yuán Tāotú was restored to it.

sense.def: restore N1 to the contextually determinate N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.6.1 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 207; tr. Watson 1989:23; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Before this episode,

sense.def: at an earlier time; in the beginning

tls:text.tls:srcline: 晉獻公欲以驪姬為夫人，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 4.6.1 (656 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 207; tr. Watson 1989:23; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Xiàn of Jìn wished to make Lady Lí his wife.

sense.def: officer on the right, attendant on the right (walking along with the carriage); spearman on the right

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.1 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: "The Teih are not ashamed to flee.

sense.def: lack a sense of shame, have no sense of shame

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.1 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: "The Teih are not ashamed to flee.

sense.def: the (proper) sense of what is publicly disgraceful, moral integrity

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.1 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: If you follow them,

sense.def: pursue (somebody or something); go after someone in order to find or retrieve him

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.1 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: you will obtain a great conquest."

sense.def: then inevitably, then invariably

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.1 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: you will obtain a great conquest."

sense.def: in a big way; very much, mightily, highly, greatly; on a large scale

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.1 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: you will obtain a great conquest."

sense.def: be victorious against a contextually determinate opponent

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.2 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: "It is best to frighten them only.

sense.def: scare, frighten; inspire fear in; intimidate

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.2 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: "Let a year be completed, and the Dí will be here again.

sense.def: after one year

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.2 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

sense.def: arrive at one's goal; arrive at the place where the speaker is

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.2 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.2.2 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.3 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: or the passage of her coffin were not announced in the ancestral temple;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.3 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

sense.def: ancestral temple (especially place of worship for the former kings or former rulers) and centre of state ritual

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.3 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:text.tls:line: or her demise were not communicated to the princes who had covenanted with her husband;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.3 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 322; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 151

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 8.5 (652 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 323; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 227; tr. Legge 152

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 9.2.4 (651 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 327; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 229; tr. Legge 154

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 9.3.1 (651 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 327; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 229; tr. Legge 154

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 9.3.1 (651 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 327; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 229; tr. Legge 154

tls:text.tls:line: banish everything contrary to good relations among us."

sense.def: good diplomatic relations; acts of friendship

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 9.3.3 (651 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 327; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 229; tr. Legge 154

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 9.3.3 (651 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 327; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 229; tr. Legge 154

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 333; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: how could there be a lack of a pretext?

sense.def: ", I wonder?"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 333; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH
