sense.def: pretended cause> pretext; excuse

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 333; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: I am ready to listen to orders."

sense.def: order to a certain person or group; a specific order

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 333; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Thereupon he fell on his sword and died.

sense.def: bend forward over (a lute, a sword in order to commit suicide)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 333; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Thereupon he fell on his sword and died.

sense.def: sword

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: At this time Pī Zhèng was on a diplomatic mission to Qín,

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he was offering his apologies for the delay in the payment of the bribe.

sense.def: apologise for V-ing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he was offering his apologies for the delay in the payment of the bribe.

sense.def: be slow with respect to; show little eagerness with regard to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he was offering his apologies for the delay in the payment of the bribe.

sense.def: bribe 受賂

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he was offering his apologies for the delay in the payment of the bribe.

sense.def: (sometimes compensatory, or promised) gift

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.2.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: As a result he remained unaffected.

sense.def: be caught up with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: The lord of Jìn had the body of the late heir, Prince Gòng (Shēn Shēng) moved to a new grave.

sense.def: rebury

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: The lord of Jìn had the body of the late heir, Prince Gòng (Shēn Shēng) moved to a new grave.

sense.def: heir apparent (examples of NP=Npr have to be moved from this)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Hú Tū, (Prince Shēn Shēng's former carriage driver,) was going down from the capital

sense.def: as it turned out in the event; by some coincidence 士適出 "this officer happened to leave the house".

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Hú Tū, (Prince Shēn Shēng's former carriage driver,) was going down from the capital

sense.def: pre-Han usage: HF 6.1.16: (walled) capital city; capital or residence of a feudal lord;MENG: 遍國 throughout the capital

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: when he encountered the late prince.

sense.def: meet by coincidence; sometimes generally: get to meet, have the opportunity to meet (someone who is hard to meet, or whom it is a good fortune to get to meet); run into, be exposed to (situations)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: The prince ordered him to climb up into his own carriage

sense.def: give orders to, order someone to V (NB: the "someone" is omitted but specified in the lexicon. This is not a case of the context allowing one to identify a person.)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and had him act as an attendant.

sense.def: act as a servant (to a contextually determinate person)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "Yí Wú shows no proper concern for ritual propriety!

sense.def: be impolite, behave impolitely; (of states:) show disregard for politeness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: I have managed to make a request to God:

sense.def: I (particularly from Warring States onwards: "I personally" rarely physically: "I purely physically (was injured etc) )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: I have managed to make a request to God:

sense.def: manage to; get to perform an act, get to; have had a chance to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: I have managed to make a request to God:

sense.def: ask for things from N; address a request to (e.g. God); plead with (a ruler) 請于公

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Then Qín is going to carry on the sacrifices to me!"

sense.def: carry out the yearly sacrifices symbolic of the continuance of the state, directed to (the deceased ruler); offer sacrifices to (a mountain etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.1 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Then Qín is going to carry on the sacrifices to me!"

sense.def: OBI: me (personally, normally not physically)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.2 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: the spirits do not accept sacrifices from those who are not of their own kind,

sense.def: delight in

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.2 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: the spirits do not accept sacrifices from those who are not of their own kind,

sense.def: 類也: be of the same category; belong to the same class of things

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.2 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and the people do not offer sacrifices to those who are not of their own clan.

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.2 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and the people do not offer sacrifices to those who are not of their own clan.

sense.def: carry out the yearly sacrifices symbolic of the continuance of the state, directed to (the deceased ruler); offer sacrifices to (a mountain etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.2 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and the people do not offer sacrifices to those who are not of their own clan.

sense.def: members of one's family; clan; tribe; kinsmen

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.2 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: The sacrifice to your lordship will surely be cut off.

sense.def: sacrifice to N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.2 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:28; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: The sacrifice to your lordship will surely be cut off.

sense.def: surely?!!!

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Moreover, what fault have the people (of Jìn) committed?

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Moreover, what fault have the people (of Jìn) committed?

sense.def: how on earth? How on earth could you/he/I? 回何敢死？ 丘何敢乎？何足憂？

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

sense.def: be guilty of a crime

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: As for wrongly applying punishments and failing to ensure the (ritually prescribed) sacrifices,

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: As for wrongly applying punishments and failing to ensure the (ritually prescribed) sacrifices,

sense.def: punishment (physical or otherwise)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: As for wrongly applying punishments and failing to ensure the (ritually prescribed) sacrifices,

sense.def: fail in, be wanting when it comes to; fail to do one's duty with respect to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: As for wrongly applying punishments and failing to ensure the (ritually prescribed) sacrifices,

sense.def: sacrifice

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: your lordship should (re)consider this!"

sense.def: you, my ruler; your lordship; you, my master

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: your lordship should (re)consider this!"

sense.def: (imperative:) must; (general:) should; had better

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

sense.def: consider carefully one's plans concerning (some action); reconsider one's plans concerning; consider concrete future action in detail, make concrete plans and arrangements as well as decisions about; make a considered decision;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: " All right.

sense.def: (Said by superior) [I hereby] approve [this]. All right! (Said by inferior) Yes!

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: I will go and ask the Emperor once more.

sense.def: again (as in 復戰 "fight again, renew battle".(often of reverting to an original state:) again (失而復得"lose but regain again") occasionally and rarely adversative: on the contrary; (with negatives, not) any more, not any longer; but again)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: I will go and ask the Emperor once more.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: there will be a shaman in the western outskirts of the New City.

sense.def: the countryside outside a city; borderland

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: there will be a shaman in the western outskirts of the New City.

sense.def: shamaness; (but note GUAN 女巫 ); generally: shaman; exorcist GY: 如是則明神降之〔六〕，在男曰覡，在女曰巫〔七〕。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: there will be a shaman in the western outskirts of the New City.

sense.def: a certain person Npr; that person Npr 有顏回者好學

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.3 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 334; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

sense.def: 有巫者: there was a certain NP; there are certain NPs

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Hú Tū agreed to this

sense.def: assent to (a superior)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and eventually the ruler disappeared.

sense.def: eventually; and so in the end, and in the event; and then, thereupon, subsequently; eventually, in the event

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: When the time came, Hú Tū went to the designated place.

sense.def: when it came to (a certain point in time) 及期"When it came to the appointed time"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: When the time came, Hú Tū went to the designated place.

sense.def: go to the contextually determinate place (often answering a summoning by a superior)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "The Emperor has given me permission to punish the guilty party.

sense.def: permit the PIVOT to do it

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "The Emperor has given me permission to punish the guilty party.

sense.def: condemn to the payment of a fine or some other form of mild punishment; generally: to punish

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.4 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Watson 1989:29; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: "The Emperor has given me permission to punish the guilty party.

sense.def: those who are guilty; the one who is guilty, the culprit

tls:text.tls:line: He will find his energies exhausted at Hán."

sense.def: exhaust one's strength; get exhausted

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.5 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157

tls:text.tls:line: When Pī Zhèng went to Qín,

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.5 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 335; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157

tls:text.tls:line: he said to the earl,

sense.def: speaking to 言於王曰 said to the king ZUO, ZGC, SHIJI, XINLUN

sense.def: the subject N is the one that V-s. 天實置之，

sense.def: install as ruler from outside the capitalinstall a minister

sense.def: nothing; none

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 10.3.6 (650 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 336; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 236; tr. Legge 157

sense.def: bribes, required gifts

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: increasingly; more and more 滋甚"ever more"

tls:text.tls:line: "Let me entreat you to recall Dà Shū (who had fled to Qí. See the Chuen after XII.3)

sense.def: may I ask you to V

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.6.1 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 280; tr. Legge 1i3

tls:text.tls:line: If brothers among ourselves cannot agree,

sense.def: be in harmonious cooperation

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.6.1 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 280; tr. Legge 1i3

tls:text.tls:srcline: 王子帶自齊復歸于京師，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.6.2 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 280; tr. Legge 1i3

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.6.2 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 280; tr. Legge 1i3

sense.def: summon officially; summon in; call in; deliver a summons (on behalf of a ruler), call in (on behalf of someone else); occasionally with abstract objects 召恥

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.7.1 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i1; tr. Legge 1i3

sense.def: prepare provisions; make preparations (against an attack); make preparations for an emergency

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.7.1 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i1; tr. Legge 1i3

tls:text.tls:line: "However small a State be,

sense.def: no matter how V1

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.7.1 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i1; tr. Legge 1i3

sense.def: be regarded as unimportant; be trifled with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.7.2 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i1; tr. Legge 1i3

tls:text.tls:line: As if we were on the brink of a deep gulf,

sense.def: as if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.7.2 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i1; tr. Legge 1i3

sense.def: as if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.7.3 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i1; tr. Legge 1i3

sense.def: poison

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.7.3 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 395; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i1; tr. Legge 1i3

sense.def: would not; refuse to; decide not to (do what one might otherwise have done); will not; fail to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: helmet

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 22.8.1 (638 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 396; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 2i2; tr. Legge 1i3

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:text.tls:line: He then accepted the document and withdrew.

sense.def: bundle of bamboo strips for writing on; document; recordsbamboo or wooden strips woven together as a mat (the character 冊 depicts this). Ordinarily hemp was used for string, but silk could be used for especially valuable writings; perhaps leather ( 韋 ) was used in a similar way. On each strip were cut triangular indentations to keep the string in place. It was common to have two or three strings ( 編, 道 ). The last strip served as a center around which the 冊 was wrapped. On the back of the first strip the title of the 冊 could be written. Each strip could have a serial number. 冊 and 策 appear to be used interchangably, except that wheras 策 is a general word for strips of any length women in the above way, 策 (cf. its original meaning of "whip") is preferably made of rather long strips. 冊 is not used for counting written material. [JP]STATIONARY

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 33.1.6 (627 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 496; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 366; tr. Watson 1989:69; revised tr. CH

sense.def: that is why S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: garden, typically gardened by a gardener, not necessarily with a fence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:text.tls:line: Now if you were to help yourselves to the deer in the Yuan Gardens

sense.def: you

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: milu deer

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 33.1.6 (627 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 496; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 366; tr. Watson 1989:69; revised tr. CH

sense.def: remain and take one's leisure in

sense.def: launch an attack (which is not necessarily successful) against; direct attack; assault, personally attack (a person); sometimes used very generally: attack (an opponent, in any way) [The examples have to be distributed into the subcategories below.]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 33.1.7 (627 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 496; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 366; tr. Watson 1989:70; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: if we besiege them, we cannot sustain the siege.

sense.def: besiege (typically a city); lay siege to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xi 33.1.7 (627 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 496; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 366; tr. Watson 1989:70; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: His name is in the records of all the States.

sense.def: bundle of bamboo strips for writing on; document; recordsbamboo or wooden strips woven together as a mat (the character 冊 depicts this). Ordinarily hemp was used for string, but silk could be used for especially valuable writings; perhaps leather ( 韋 ) was used in a similar way. On each strip were cut triangular indentations to keep the string in place. It was common to have two or three strings ( 編, 道 ). The last strip served as a center around which the 冊 was wrapped. On the back of the first strip the title of the 冊 could be written. Each strip could have a serial number. 冊 and 策 appear to be used interchangably, except that wheras 策 is a general word for strips of any length women in the above way, 策 (cf. its original meaning of "whip") is preferably made of rather long strips. 冊 is not used for counting written material. [JP]STATIONARY

sense.def: OBI 5: acute sickness; current state of sickness; also: xīn jí 心疾 "indisposition/illness of the heart/mind"; sickness 斯疾 temporary indisposition; falling sick

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: the capital of the contextually determinate state/place

tls:text.tls:line: so as to enjoy the providence of Heaven.

sense.def: politely receive (e.g. responsibilities from a superior); continue to receive; HF 9.1.23: accept (the ruler's line of thought)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.4 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: so as to enjoy the providence of Heaven.

sense.def: blessings (from Heaven) 天休（庥）

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.4 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: When Jié (the last ruler of the Hsia) had an obscure inner virtue

sense.def: dark and obscure;by extension: confused; benighted; obscured

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.4 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and the tripods were transferred to the Shang dynasty,

sense.def: get moved to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.4 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: whose years numbered six hundred.

sense.def: age (of a physical object); years of age reached, the number of years something lasts

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.4 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: But emperor Chou of the Shang was violent and tyrannical,

sense.def: be cruel and violent; 甚暴虐

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.4 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and the cauldrons passed to the Chou dynasty.

sense.def: get moved to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.4 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: When virtue is distinguished and brilliant,

sense.def: be excellent and distinguished

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.5 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2

tls:text.tls:line: But when there is depravity and disorder,

sense.def: there is wickedness, depravity

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.5 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2

tls:text.tls:line: But when there is depravity and disorder,

sense.def: there is chaos

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.5 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2

tls:text.tls:line: they are lightweight.

sense.def: be powerless, be weak

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.5 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2

tls:text.tls:line: The good fortune from Heaven and brilliant virtue

sense.def: good fortune (from heaven)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.5 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2

tls:text.tls:line: The good fortune from Heaven and brilliant virtue

sense.def: bright virtuous power

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.5 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n671; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2

tls:text.tls:line: has its limit and end.

sense.def: be blocked, be stopped

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: When King Chéng (of Zhòu) put the cauldrons in place at his capital in Jiárù,

sense.def: put in place

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: he divined by the tortoiseshell the number of generations (of his dynasty) with the result "thirty",

sense.def: divine by the use of cracks in a turtle shell;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: and he divined to determine the number of years with the result "seven hundred".

sense.def: divine by the use of cracks in a turtle shell;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: This was mandated by Heaven.

sense.def: decree as fate, mandate

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: Thus the moral authority of the Zhōu may have declined,

sense.def: the highest form of virtue, true virtue, true inner power

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: but the mandate of Heaven is not yet ready to be transferred to another dynasty.

sense.def: appointment by Heaven, Mandate of Heaven to a ruler

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: but the mandate of Heaven is not yet ready to be transferred to another dynasty.

sense.def: not yet

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: but the mandate of Heaven is not yet ready to be transferred to another dynasty.

sense.def: be changed for something better; be improved

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: As for the weight of the tripods

sense.def: weight

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: these are not really things one should ask about!"

sense.def: not quite; not really

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.3.6 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 494; tr. Watson 1989:i2; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: these are not really things one should ask about!"

sense.def: be asked about 未可問

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.4.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 293

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.4.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 293

sense.def: become politically close to; become culturally close to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.5.1(606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 293

tls:text.tls:line: he put to death his full brother, Seu, and the son of duke Chao,

sense.def: brother by the same mother (and father) by the name of Npr

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.5.1(606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 293

sense.def: and [no examples in LY]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.5.2 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:text.tls:line: and drove out of the State the clans of Woo and Muh.

sense.def: chase away, drive away; banish from one's presence; oust (a ruler etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.5.2 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:text.tls:line: in return for the disorders occasioned by the officer Woo.

sense.def: respond; repay; retaliate; reward; revenge; act in response to

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:text.tls:line: (His father), duke Wan, had a concubine of mean position, who was called Yen K'eih (As belonging to the House of the southern Yen),

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:text.tls:line: (His father), duke Wan, had a concubine of mean position, who was called Yen K'eih (As belonging to the House of the southern Yen),

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:text.tls:line: (His father), duke Wan, had a concubine of mean position, who was called Yen K'eih (As belonging to the House of the southern Yen),

sense.def: called; an N1 called N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6.1 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n672; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: name of plant NOT identical with the orchid (but like an orchid?)

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6 (606 B.C.); Y:673; W:497; tr. Legge 294

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6 (606 B.C.); Y:673; W:497; tr. Legge 294

tls:text.tls:line: so shall men acknowledge and love him."

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 3.6.3 (606 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2Ju4n673; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 497; tr. Legge 294

tls:text.tls:line: "I am but a poor concubine,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: together with the contextually determinate N

sense.def: 不免有殺身之禍have (someone/onself) killed; cause someone/oneself to lose his life, The general word, to be used about animals as well as humans (and occasionally about plants as well), for whatever cause or reason and with whatever means; (sometimes the killed person comes to life again as in ZUO 7.8.1.1)

tls:text.tls:line: the former agreeing that his son Keang should go to Tsin as a hostage.

sense.def: hostage

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.1 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 334

tls:text.tls:line: On this the army of Tsin returned,

sense.def: make an about turn and withdraw, turn back, head back; turn round in order to withdraw or return to where one comes from, or retrace one's steps

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.1 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 334

tls:text.tls:line: and Ts'ae Chaou and Nan-kwoh Yen made their escape back to Ts'e.

sense.def: flee home

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.2 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 334

tls:text.tls:line: In summer,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.2 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 334

tls:text.tls:line: the duke sent to Ts'oo, to ask the assistance of an army;

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

sense.def: injure (often a ruler) deliberately, with lethal consequences (ZUO, GU)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: 弒 indicates that the perpetrator was one of the prince's own subjects.

sense.def: be ruthlessly harmful to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: 弒 indicates that the perpetrator was one of the prince's own subjects.

sense.def: to assassinate

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: 戕 is the character employed to denote the murder of the prince of a State by some one of another State.

sense.def: to murder

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 777; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: 戕 is the character employed to denote the murder of the prince of a State by some one of another State.

sense.def: injure (often a ruler) deliberately, with lethal consequences (ZUO, GU)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: the army (The help of which Loo had asked) did not come forth.

sense.def: be sent out; (of troops:) be brought out into battle

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: Afterwards Loo availed itself of an army of Tsin (See VIII. ii.2),

sense.def: then in the end

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: in consequence of which Ts'oo had the meeting and covenant at Shuh (VIII.ii.10).

sense.def: N then V-ed; N thus V-ed

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i1; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: in consequence of which Ts'oo had the meeting and covenant at Shuh (VIII.ii.10).

sense.def: N then V-ed

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.1 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: whose elevation was due to (Kwei-foo's father), Seang-chung.

sense.def: have favour with the contextually determinate person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.1 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: and thereby increase the power of the ducal House,

sense.def: cause to expand> benefit, work for

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.1 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: and thereby increase the power of the ducal House,

sense.def: strengthen vtoN@causative

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.1 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: he consulted with the duke,

sense.def: 與之盟/戰

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.1 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: and went on a friendly mission to Tsin,

sense.def: pay a formal visit to (normally a state)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.2 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: on the death of the duke,

sense.def: of senior officials: die [occasionally also used to refer to the death of an emperor]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.2 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: "It was Chung who made us kill the son of the proper wife,

sense.def: direct descendent of the ducal house

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.2 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: and set up the son of another,

sense.def: a commoner

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.2 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: and set up the son of another,

sense.def: helper; supporting force

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.2 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: so as to lose the great helper we might have calculated on."

sense.def: n'est-ce pas?

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: But if you wish to send their clan away,

sense.def: remove, do away with, get rid of; try to drive away (ants); take off

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: allow me to do it."

sense.def: remove, do away with, get rid of; try to drive away (ants); take off

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.3 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 778; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: Accordingly, he drove the Tung-mun clan out of the State.

sense.def: chase away, drive away; banish from one's presence; oust (a ruler etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: Tsze-kea had then returned from Tsin

sense.def: turn round; be on one's way back; having turned back (and being thus on one's way back)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: he took off his upper garment, bound his hair up with sackcloth,

sense.def: to bare upper arm showing either one's underwear or one's bare shoulders; also: bare the upper part of one's body

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: he took off his upper garment, bound his hair up with sackcloth,

sense.def: tie; bind; tie up; bring together

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: he took off his upper garment, bound his hair up with sackcloth,

sense.def: hair; human hair on the head

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: went to the place for it and wept,

sense.def: wail; lament

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.4 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

sense.def: SHI: jump up; LIJI: jump up as sign of extreme mourning stump the ground; leap about

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.5 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: The style of the paragraph,- 'Kwei-foo returned from Tsin,"

sense.def: writings; written document of any kind; often specifically: official document; book; stationary

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.5 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: The style of the paragraph,- 'Kwei-foo returned from Tsin,"

sense.def: make an about turn and withdraw, turn back, head back; turn round in order to withdraw or return to where one comes from, or retrace one's steps

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xuan 18.5.5 (591 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 779; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 5i2; tr. Legge: 335

tls:text.tls:line: is commendatory for him.

sense.def: declare to be good

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: and duke Seang of Shen went to Tsin to express (the king's) acknowledgment of the service.

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: "You will be violating the covenant, and doing despite to the great State;

sense.def: revolt against, turn one's back on; go against; fail to conform to

tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: To violate a covenant is inauspicious;

sense.def: revolt against, turn one's back on; go against; fail to conform to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

sense.def: oath; the swearing of oaths of allegiance

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: To violate a covenant is inauspicious;

sense.def: be inauspicious

sense.def: (primarily of human actions:)祥"be of good omen; be deserving of good luck"; 不祥"be of evil omen"; be of good omen, be liable to provoke a positive response from the supernatural world

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: to do despite to the great State is unrighteous.

sense.def: cheat through word or action; treat dishonestly, deceive; perpetrate fraud against 欺於

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: to do despite to the great State is unrighteous.

sense.def: wrongful deed; unjust thing suffered; injustice; failure to act properly

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: Neither spirits nor men will help you in such a course;

sense.def: man in general; man in the true sense of that word, man who deserves the name of man

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: Neither spirits nor men will help you in such a course;

sense.def: would not; refuse to; decide not to (do what one might otherwise have done); will not; fail to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.2 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: and how can you expect to conquer?"

sense.def: be successful; be fully up to one's job

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.1.3 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:text.tls:line: but proceeded to invade the Maou Jung;

sense.def: "Reed Barbarians"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: get defeated

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.2.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.3.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 337

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

sense.def: to come in order to V; come so as to V; come for the purpose of Ving

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.4.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585

sense.def: read braads: defeat, failure

tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.5.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 338

sense.def: newly, recently; lately; just

tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.5.1 (590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 338

tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 1.5.2(590 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 7i4; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 585; tr. Legge: 338

知難而有備，
乃可以逞。」

tls:text.tls:line: When we see our difficulties and make preparations for them, they may be resolved."

sense.def: please oneself, work for one's own satisfaction; get a satisfactory outcome; have one's way

tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.18 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 793; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:114

tls:text.tls:line: The previous evening, when Feng Ch'ou-fu was sleeping in one of the troops wagons,

sense.def: sleeping carriage

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.18 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 793; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:114

tls:text.tls:line: a snake had crawled out from under the wagon

sense.def: generally: snake; also: snake-like dragon

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.18 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 793; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:114

tls:text.tls:line: and bitten him in the forearm,

sense.def: whole arm, with particular focus on the upper arm; specifically refers to the bent arm

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.18 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 793; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:114

tls:text.tls:line: but he had concealed the wound (so as to be able to attend the duke in battle).

sense.def: hide; hide from; keep in the dark

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.19 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 794; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:115

tls:text.tls:line: and thus Han Chueh caught up with them.

sense.def: catch up with the contextually determinate object

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.20 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 794; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:115

tls:text.tls:line: Your humbled servant,

sense.def: I, lowly servant (Warring States)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.20 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 794; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:115

tls:text.tls:line: has unfortunately been unable to avoid doing so,

sense.def: flee so as to be able to hide

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.22 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 794; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:115

tls:text.tls:line: Here is a man who does so,

sense.def: a hypothetical place here

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.23 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 795; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:115

tls:text.tls:line: The Ti soldiers all bared their halberds as though to attack,

sense.def: pull out so as to use 抽刀 "pull a dagger", also 抽戈 "pull out a lance (presumably from a stand, in preparation for using it)"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.24 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 795; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: The Wei troops likewise allowed him to esape.

sense.def: cause/allow to escape

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.25 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 796; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: "Has the leader of the crack troops escaped?"

sense.def: the excellent, those of select quality; the crack troops

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.25 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 796; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: "If the ruler and my father have escaped,

sense.def: and 吾與汝俱不如也

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.26 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 796; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 596; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: The Ch'i ruler dispatched Pin Mei-jen to offer as gifts

sense.def: bribe contextually determinate recipients (以 "with" something)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.27 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 797; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: Pin Fei-jen offered his gifts,

sense.def: hand up

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.27 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 797; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: Pin Fei-jen offered his gifts,

sense.def: (sometimes compensatory, or promised) gift

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.27 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 797; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: and Ch'i must make certain that all the divisions between the fields within its domain

sense.def: border marked by raised earth marked with trees; 四封，封洫generally: border

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.27 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 797; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:116

tls:text.tls:line: run east and west."

sense.def: high ridge between fields

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.29 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 797; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: But if you issue such an unfilial order as this to the other feudal lords,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.30 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: When the kings of former times divided up the world and established boundaries,

sense.def: cause to have proper boundaries; make boundaries for; demarcate territory of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.30 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: When the kings of former times divided up the world and established boundaries,

sense.def: divide up into sections; make boundaries

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.31(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: This will be to the advantage of none but your war chariots,

sense.def: this aforementioned N; the preceding N (is the one the SUBJECT VERBS) 敗是求 "it is defeat that you have sought"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.31(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: for it ignores what is right for the land.

sense.def: turn one's attention to; pay proper attention to, take cognizance of, take note of; concentrate on (at the expense of other things); be concerned for, worry about 不顧

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.31(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: for it ignores what is right for the land.

sense.def: suitability; appropriateness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.31(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: for it ignores what is right for the land.

sense.def: what is appropriate and helpful

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.31(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: To convert the former kings is to act unrighteously,

sense.def: oppose, work against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.31(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: It would appear that in fact Chin lacks the qualifications for that role!

sense.def: defect, shortcoming; shortfall; deficiencies; defaults

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.32 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: they were diligent and worked to win over the other feudal lords

sense.def: be industrious and strenous in one's efforts, make strenuous efforts, be assiduous

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.32 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 798; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:117

tls:text.tls:line: by seeking to satisfy boundless desires.

sense.def: limit, bounds 無疆 "without bounds"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.34 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: But my forces, quailing before your ruler's might,

sense.def: stand in fear of; fear, be very much afraid of and at the same time in awe of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.34 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: But my forces, quailing before your ruler's might,

sense.def: power, might

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.35 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: If so, then our only thought will be to offer you these insignificant articles that belonged to our former rulers

sense.def: (our/my) former rulers

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.35 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 599; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: then we beg permission to gather up the scattered ashes of our army,

sense.def: unburnable substances (also other than ashes) that remain after something has been burnt; ashes; ZUO metaphorically: leftovers (as of a country after its complete destruction)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.36(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: "The ruler of Ch'i hates us!

sense.def: be resentful of; resent (often but not always (cf. LY) out of envy); detest

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.36(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: The men he has lost in this battle

sense.def: die in one way or another

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.36(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: If you do not agree to his terms,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.36(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: he is bound to look on us with severe enmity!

sense.def: regard as an enemy of hostile competitor> abhor; feel enmity towards, feel hostile towards

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.37 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: "If now we may report back to our ruler

sense.def: if really

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.37 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: We are prepared to abide by your command in all things."

sense.def: this aforementioned N; the preceding N (is the one the SUBJECT VERBS) 敗是求 "it is defeat that you have sought"

tls:text.tls:srcline: 晉師及齊國佐盟于爰婁。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.38 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 799; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:118

tls:text.tls:line: the Chin army and the representatives of Ch'i, Pin Fei-jen, concluded an alliance at Yuan-Lou.

sense.def: 衛人及狄盟 N2 V-s, in conjunction/cooperation/interaction with N1 (In the following the first designates joint action, the second interaction: 叔孫豹及諸侯之大夫及陳袁僑盟。 公及楚公子嬰齊、蔡侯、許男、秦右大夫說、宋華元、陳公孫寧、衛孫良夫、鄭公子去疾及齊國之大夫盟于蜀。)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.3.39 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 800; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 603; tr. Watson 1989:119

tls:text.tls:line: He presented to each of the three Chin commanders a ceremonial carriage and robes

sense.def: give (a present N2) to (a recipient N1 of lower status)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.4.1 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 801; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 605; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: duke Wan of Sung died.

sense.def: come to an end> die

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.4.1 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 801; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 605; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: For the first time men were interred with the corpse.

sense.def: the burying of others to honour a distinguished deceased person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.4.2(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 802; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 605; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: The superior man will say: 'Hwa Yuen and Yoh Keu

sense.def: a person of superior character; the person of superior character 得見君子者斯可矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.4.2(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 802; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 605; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: did not act on this occasion as ministers ought to do.

sense.def: here and now

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.4.2(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 802; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 605; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: having nothing about them of the proper character of ministers.'

sense.def: how? (i.e. in no way); for what? to what purpose? (with or without additional 何)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.2 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 803; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: One of the Books of Chow (Shoo, V.ix.2) says,

sense.def: writings; written document of any kind; often specifically: official document; book; stationary

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.2 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 803; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: Let your lordship well consider the matter."

sense.def: (imperative:) must; (general:) should; had better

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.4 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 804; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: why must you have this one?"

sense.def: why does it have to be an N? what need is there for N?

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.6 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 804; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: "The thing is true.

sense.def: be reliably true, be trustworthy; be certainly the case

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.6 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 804; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: was a favourite with duke Ch'ing (of Tsin)

sense.def: political favourite

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.6 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 804; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: He has recently been made assistant-commander of the army of the centre,

sense.def: newly, recently; lately; just

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.6 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 804; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: He has recently been made assistant-commander of the army of the centre,

sense.def: Central Army (often commandeered by the ruler or the duke); Central Army Command

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.7 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 804; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: and anxious to conciliate its favour,

sense.def: close friendship or alliance (between states or persons)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.7 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 804; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 606; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: I will not return here."

sense.def: return, get back to where one came from; make one's return; flee back

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.8(589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: After the accession of king Kung (in Ts'oo)

sense.def: when it came to the point that S, by the time that S, at the point when S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.9 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: You have the anxiety of all the armies of the State on your mind,

sense.def: the combined military forces of a state

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.9 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: You ought to be stealing a marriage with some lady!"

sense.def: be obliged to; ought to, should fittingly, have a duty to; deserve to be (VERBED); it is right that; shall

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.9 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: You ought to be stealing a marriage with some lady!"

sense.def: get (a position etc) by inappropriate or illegal means

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.9 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 347

tls:text.tls:line: You ought to be stealing a marriage with some lady!"

sense.def: escape, get away; abscond

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.10 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 348

tls:text.tls:line: When Woo-shin got to Ch'ing,

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.10 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 348

tls:text.tls:line: he sent his assistant in the mission back to Ts'oo with the presents (he had received for Ts'e),

sense.def: give back N1 to the contextually determinate N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.10 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 805; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 348

tls:text.tls:line: but as its army had sustained the recent defeat,

sense.def: newly, recently; lately; just

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.12 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 806; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 348

tls:text.tls:line: If he prove of advantage to it, moreover,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.6.12 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 806; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 609; tr. Legge: 348

tls:text.tls:line: If he prove of advantage to it, moreover,

sense.def: 我國家the nation including its leading clans; our nation, my nation, the nation in question, the polity; their nation

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.7.1 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 806; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 611; tr. Watson 1989:119

tls:text.tls:line: and the people of the state were greeting it with joy.

sense.def: with glee; with delight; showing open delight

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.7.1 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 806; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 611; tr. Watson 1989:119

tls:text.tls:line: and the people of the state were greeting it with joy.

sense.def: welcome; go out to welcome (a bride etc); go out to meet as a gesture of politeness or submission

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.8.3 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 807; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 612; tr. Legge: 348

tls:text.tls:line: Moreover, our late ruler, duke Chwang, gave an order saying,

sense.def: speak to (someone)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.8.3 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 807; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 612; tr. Legge: 348

tls:text.tls:line: 'When our virtue is not sufficient to reach to distant regions,

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 2.8.3 (589 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 807; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 612; tr. Legge: 348
