tls:text.tls:line: God has promised me revenge!"

sense.def: request

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.1 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:120

tls:text.tls:line: God has promised me revenge!"

sense.def: sovereign; high deity

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.1 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:120

tls:text.tls:line: The ogre broke down the main gate of the palace,

sense.def: living quarters; building with bedrooms; private chambers; imposing building with inner chambers

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.2 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: The shaman described the duke's dream just as it has been.

sense.def: shamaness; (but note GUAN 女巫 ); generally: shaman; exorcist GY: 如是則明神降之〔六〕，在男曰覡，在女曰巫〔七〕。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.2 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: replied the shaman.

sense.def: fresh things (offerings); fresh fruit, fresh crop

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.2 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: The duke fell gravely ill

sense.def: suffer from a serious illness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.2 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: and sent for a doctor from the state of Ch'in.

sense.def: medically specialised shaman; medical doctor8

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.3 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: the duke dreamt that his illness appeared to him in the form of two little boys.

sense.def: boy 五尺之豎子; 二豎子 miserable little boy; little wretch; servant boy

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.3 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: is a skilled physician

sense.def: a good doctor

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.3 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n i49; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: Where can we flee?"

sense.def: escape into, escape to (a place, or a person who protects one)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.4(5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: When the physician arrived,

sense.def: medically specialised shaman; medical doctor8

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.4(5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: "I can do nothing for your illness.

sense.def: be cured 不可為 "nothing can be done about it"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.4(5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: where treatment cannot affect it,

sense.def: try to deal with effectively, attack (a disease or a weak point)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.4(5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: There is nothing I can do."

sense.def: be cured 不可為 "nothing can be done about it"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.5 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: said the duke, and

sense.def: fine; competent; efficient; excellent; preferred

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.5 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: said the duke, and

sense.def: a good doctor

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.5 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: said the duke, and

sense.def: medically specialised shaman; medical doctor8

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: but his stomach swelled up and,

sense.def: swell

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: hurrying to the privy,

sense.def: go to a place, not on any official mission

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: hurrying to the privy,

sense.def: the general term for the small building housing the toilet, and this building being on the side of the main building. Hence the euphemistic name "side-building"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: he fell down the hole and died.

sense.def: fall into the contextually determinate place

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: and consequently he was delegated that day

sense.def: it reaches a time of (so-and-so many years)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.4.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 659; tr. Watson 1989:121

tls:text.tls:line: and consequently he was delegated that day

sense.def: midday, noon

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.5.1 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 850; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 662;L:374

tls:text.tls:line: The superior man will say,

sense.def: a person of superior character; the person of superior character 得見君子者斯可矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 851; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 662;L:374

tls:text.tls:line: went to Tsin,

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 851; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 662;L:374

tls:text.tls:line: At this time T'aou Fei had not returned from Ts'oo (See the Chuen at the beginning of the year).

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.6 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 851; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 662;L:374

tls:text.tls:line: At this time T'aou Fei had not returned from Ts'oo (See the Chuen at the beginning of the year).

sense.def: return, get back to where one came from; make one's return; flee back

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 10.7 (5i1 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 851; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 663;L:374

tls:text.tls:line: and the historiographers of Loo, because of the disgrace connected with the thing,

sense.def: regard as humilating, regard as disgraceful

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.3.2 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 663;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: who took his half-sister from She Heaou-shuh, and gave her to him.

sense.def: give (something) to (a beneficiary)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.3 .3(580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 663;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: "I am not able to die for you."

sense.def: die in one way or another

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.3.4 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 663;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: "You could not protect me when I was your wife,

sense.def: he himself, she herself

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.4 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: Ke Wan-tsze went to Tsin on a friendly mission on return for that of Keoh Ch'ow;

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.4 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: and to make a covenant (on the part of Loo).

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.5.1 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: (the clans descended from the kings) Hwuy and Seang,

sense.def: threatening behaviour; pressure

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.5.1 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: and he had a contention, moreover, about the chief place in the government with Pih-yu.

sense.def: 與秦戰 with, against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.5.1 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 853; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: proceeding to Yang-fan.

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.7.1 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: had a contention with (the court of) Chow about the lands of How.

sense.def: 與秦戰 with, against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.7.2 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: and his territory and that of the earl of T'an extended to the Ho.

sense.def: make a boundary at

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.7.3 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: and then it came to K'eoh. CHECK TEXT

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.7.3 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: If you examine its history,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.7.3 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: how can Keoh Che be allowed to have it?

sense.def: how? (idiomatic in 安得 "how can one get to?", 安敢"how would I dare to?")

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.8 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: Hwa Yen of Sung was on good terms with Tsze-chung, the chief minister (of Ts'oo),

sense.def: be on good terms with N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.8 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: first to Ts'oo

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.8 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: and then to Tsin,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 11.9.2 (580 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 854; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 665;L:376

tls:text.tls:line: to establish their good faith;

sense.def: trust, confidence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.1 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: this summer, in the fifth month,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.2 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: and be ready to relieve such as are unfortunate.

sense.def: serious trouble, misfortune; resulting trouble (from one's actions) 三患"three kinds of disaster"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.2 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

sense.def: conform to, act in conformity with, act in accordance with; do as in the case of, act as in the case of; act accordingly

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.3 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: Their roads shall be open to messengers

sense.def: ceremonial gift

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.3 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: that wish to pass with their offerings from the one to the other.

sense.def: the roads, all kinds of roads

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.3 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: Whoever shall violate this covenant,

sense.def: repudiate, go back on, deviate from[that word might fit better into another syn. group][CA]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.3 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: (After this), the earl of Ch'ing went to Tsin, to receive (the conditions of) peace,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.2.3 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 856; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 668;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: (After this), the earl of Ch'ing went to Tsin, to receive (the conditions of) peace,

sense.def: accept (an offer of a truce etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.1 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 857; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: Keoh Che of Tsin went to Ts'oo on a friendly mission,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.1 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 857; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: which frightened him so that he ran out.

sense.def: be frightened

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.2 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 857; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: extends his favour to my poor self,

sense.def: yì jí: reach upto> affect, reach so far as to affect

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.3 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 857; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: I dare not receive (such an honour)."

sense.def: I, lowly servant (Warring States)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.4 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 857; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: "If it be an arrow that they mutually offer and decline,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.4 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 857; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: there will be no blessing in that.

sense.def: how? (i.e. in no way); for what? to what purpose? (with or without additional 何)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.4 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 857; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: the princes, in their intervals of leisure from the king's business,

sense.def: the emperor (unspecified, at such-and-such a time)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.5 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: Then there are the ceremonies of entertainment and feasting;

sense.def: then, thereupon; at that moment

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.5 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: then the people enjoy rest,

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.5 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: then the people enjoy rest,

sense.def: the N therefore V-s

tls:text.tls:srcline: 此公侯之所以扞城其民也。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.6 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: It is in this way that the princes prove themselves the protectors of their people.

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.6 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: But in a time of disorder,

sense.def: when it came to the period when (something happened or was going on)> while (someone was alive)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.6 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:378

tls:text.tls:line: and for a few feet of territory will destroy their people,

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.7 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:379

tls:text.tls:line: the princes are shields and walls to the people,

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.7 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:379

tls:text.tls:line: but in a time of disorder, it is the reverse.

sense.def: be opposed to; be inconsistent with, be at variance with; be the opposite of, be contrary to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.8 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:379

tls:text.tls:line: and I will not presume to disobey you."

sense.def: how would I dare not to> certainly!

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Cheng 12.4.9 (579 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 858; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 670;L:379

tls:text.tls:line: the Kung-tsze P'e of Ts'oo went to Tsin on a friendly mission,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:text.tls:srcline: 晉侯及楚公子罷盟于赤棘。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:text.tls:line: whose own instructor in the art had been the Kung-sun Ting.

sense.def: study (some skill N1) with (a master N2), study ( a subject N1) under (a master N2) 學於孔子

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.8 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: whose own instructor in the art had been the Kung-sun Ting.

sense.def: aim to learn (a skill); learn to read (a text), recite and understand according to received interpretation (a text); devote oneself to, apply oneself to (cultural studies etc); learn from a teacher about (a subject)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.8 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: Yin-kung T'o and Yu-kung Ch'ae continued the pursuit of the duke.

sense.def: go after, pursue, try to catch up with (and perhaps catch)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.8 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: Ting was now driving the duke's chariot,

sense.def: drive (for a person), act as a driver for (someone)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.8 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: and Tsze-yu (Yu-kung Ch'ae) said,

sense.def: See in Unger 891

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.8 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: "If I shoot, I do violence to my instructor;

sense.def: revolt against, turn one's back on; go against; fail to conform to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.8 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: "If I shoot, I do violence to my instructor;

sense.def: 人師,民師 teacher, guiding authority; sometimes specifically: music master

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.8 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: and if I do not shoot, I shall be killed;

sense.def: get killed

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.9 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: Accordingly he shot twice, (merely) hitting the yoke over the horses' necks,

sense.def: curved exterior part of a yoke, gripping over the neck of the horse (Tso)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.9 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1012; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: and returned.

sense.def: make an about turn and withdraw, turn back, head back; turn round in order to withdraw or return to where one comes from, or retrace one's steps

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.10 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1013; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: and thereon he turned again in pursuit.

sense.def: change direction, take a new direction

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.10 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1013; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: The Kung-sun Ting gave the reins to the duke, and sent an arrow

sense.def: hand over (something N2) to (someone N1); confer (something N2) upon (someone N1)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.10 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1013; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:text.tls:line: through the upper part of To's arm.

sense.def: pierce

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.10 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1013; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

sense.def: whole arm

公使祝宗告亡，

及竟，

tls:text.tls:srcline:

公使祝宗告亡，

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 14.4.12 (559 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1013; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 849; tr. Legge: 465

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: make submit to one's will, control, keep control over; order about

tls:text.tls:line: You are but a feeble clan,

sense.def: members of one's family; clan; tribe; kinsmen

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.17 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 902; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: and in the State there are many great nobles.

sense.def: favourites

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.17 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 902; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: If unfriendly persons were setting them against you,

sense.def: wicked

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.17 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 902; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: On what (other) ground should I grudge her our husband's favours?"

sense.def: I (particularly from Warring States onwards: "I personally" rarely physically: "I purely physically (was injured etc) )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.18 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 902; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: She then sent the lady to her husband's couch;

sense.def: sleep with a contextually determinate person N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.18 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 902; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: He was remarkable for his beauty, courage, and strength,

sense.def: courage of one's convictions; moral strength

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.18 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 902; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: and became a favourite with Hwae-tsze,

sense.def: be a favourite to; have as a favourite

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.18 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 902; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: became involved in (the present) difficulties.

sense.def: meet (difficulties)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: When Lwan Ying was passing by Chow,

sense.def: pass by, pass through

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: the people in its western borders plundered him,

sense.def: border area

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: the people in its western borders plundered him,

sense.def: misappropriate by military force or by violent means

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: on which he complained to a messenger (from the king), saying,

sense.def: Diplomatic Secretary; master of etiquette; official emissary of lower status than the formal envoy 使

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: "I, Ying, a servant of the son of Heaven, belonging to another State,

sense.def: the (contextually determinate) Son of Heaven (of the time)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: "I, Ying, a servant of the son of Heaven, belonging to another State,

sense.def: your humble minister N 陪臣盈

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: offended the king's servant, who is its guardian.

sense.def: fall foul of, commit a crime against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.19 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1061; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: offended the king's servant, who is its guardian.

sense.def: civil servant

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.20 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: Trying to excape from the consequences of my guilt,

sense.def: escape from; avoid by running away from; run away from, abscond from (difficulties, contracts etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.20 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: I have trespassed again on your borders.

sense.def: border area; outlying area

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.20 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: let me venture to set forth the question of my death:

sense.def: announce generally to the officials; announce; make known, make public; comment on publicly

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.20 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: let me venture to set forth the question of my death:

sense.def: my

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.20 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: let me venture to set forth the question of my death:

sense.def: death, also abstract: the fact of dying; mode of dying

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: Formerly, Your Majesty's servant, (my grandfather), Shoo,

sense.def: subsidiary minister (typically one who comes from a state other than that he is serving in)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 其子黶不能保任其父之勞。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: His son Yen was not able to preserve and continue the services of Shoo;

sense.def: take good care of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: and now, O great ruler, if you have not forgotten the zealous duty of Shoo,

sense.def: Your Great Excellence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: and now, O great ruler, if you have not forgotten the zealous duty of Shoo,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: then there will be a way of escape for me.

sense.def: your doomed humble servant

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

sense.def: escape into, escape to (a place, or a person who protects one)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: If you have forgotten that,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.21 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: and think of the guilt of Yen,

sense.def: be preoccupied by; linger in thought on; reflect on, be mindful of, think about

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.22. (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: I dare not go back.

sense.def: make an about turn and withdraw, turn back, head back; turn round in order to withdraw or return to where one comes from, or retrace one's steps

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.22. (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: I have presumed to declare every thing;

sense.def: all parts, everything

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.22. (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: it is for you, O great ruler, to issue your command."

sense.def: Your Great Excellence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.22. (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

sense.def: give orders to the contextually determinate person N (often the speaker)

tls:text.tls:line: "To go on thus to wrong him as (Tsin) has done

sense.def: berate, to blame, to hold morally guilty See also GUILT

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.23 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: "To go on thus to wrong him as (Tsin) has done

sense.def: HF 8.1.15: emulate (the sage); imitate; live up to; act according to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.23 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: would be acting worse than Tsin."

sense.def: even more

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.5.23 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1062; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 906; tr. Legge: 491

sense.def: be more intense than; be stronger than 甚於

sense.def: after number phrase 三家者， 之數物者

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.7.1 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 491

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.7.1 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: are standard ceremonies;

sense.def: ritual propriety, the rules and principles of ritual propriety; the demands of ritual

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: the warp> underlying principles and rules

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.7.1 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 491

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.7.1 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 491

sense.def: abstract vehicle

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.7.1 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 491

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.7.1 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 491

tls:text.tls:line: that men's persons are guarded.

sense.def: often reflexive: one's (own) person; one's (own) person and character; the Self; personality (as something cultivated by the gentleman); the character

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.7.1 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 491

sense.def: defensive/self-protective measure

sense.def: hero; outstanding personality 兩雄

tls:text.tls:line: "If your lordship thinks them heroes,

sense.def: hero; outstanding personality 兩雄

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.8.3 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 492

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.8.4 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 492

sense.def: be complicit with; have connections with; be implicated in; be on good practical terms with

sense.def: be recent (in one's job etc); be a recent event

tls:text.tls:line: "As to those two,

sense.def: after number phrase 三家者， 之數物者

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.8.5 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 492

sense.def: resemble

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 21.8.5 (552 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1063; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 908; tr. Legge: 492

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.3 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.3 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:text.tls:line: And if you, my master, put your confidence in these things,

sense.def: you

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.3 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:text.tls:line: And if you, my master, put your confidence in these things,

sense.def: SHU: depend on politically (as on a powerful person), depend on (for life); derive profit from 甚賴之

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.4 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:text.tls:line: A good name

sense.def: archaic: impressive in a contrived way; attractive

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.4 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

sense.def: good reputation

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.4 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

sense.def: abstract vehicle

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.4 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:text.tls:line: is the (sure) foundation of a State.

sense.def: the nation; a nation

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.4 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.4 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.5 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.5 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.5 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.6 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

sense.def: show up, make clear; show up in a positive light, show up the virtues of

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 24.2.6 (549 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1089; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 937; tr. Legge: 507

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.11 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1130; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 532

sense.def: 衛人及狄盟 N2 V-s, in conjunction/cooperation/interaction with N1 (In the following the first designates joint action, the second interaction: 叔孫豹及諸侯之大夫及陳袁僑盟。 公及楚公子嬰齊、蔡侯、許男、秦右大夫說、宋華元、陳公孫寧、衛孫良夫、鄭公子去疾及齊國之大夫盟于蜀。)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: side

tls:text.tls:line: "The spirit of Ts'oo is very bad.

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.13 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: parenthetic: - it is to be feared/I'm afraid -

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.13 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: "We are on the left, and can turn

sense.def: turn to one side, make a detour; veer to one side; turn round again

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: wear as underwear

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: armour made of leather [often lacquered Jakob Marsalek]

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: this (particular abstract thing)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 992; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: win over; cause be be obedient, cause to submit; tame; cause to surrender, subdue; cause to agree (that one's claims are true)

sense.def: armour made of leather [often lacquered Jakob Marsalek]

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.15(546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 994; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: "There has been no good faith between Tsin and Ts'oo for long.

sense.def: credibility; trustworthiness, good faith, dependability, reliability

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.15(546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 994; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.15(546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 994; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.15(546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 994; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.16 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 994; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.16 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 994; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: it is by the words that good faith is declared;

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.16 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 994; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.17 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1131; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: wear as underwear

tls:text.tls:line: It will not do for even

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.18 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: infringement of promises, failure of good faith, faithlessness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.18 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: get into trouble; suffer disaster

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.18 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: and with Sung doing the same,

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: and with Sung doing the same,

sense.def: sacrifice on behalf of superiors

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: be frightened; be afraid; [of a voice or of a person: be fearful. But this has to be moved CH]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: Having called the States together to put a stop to war,

sense.def: put an end to; stop; reduce radically

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: Having called the States together to put a stop to war,

sense.def: warfare

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.19 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.20 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: oath; the swearing of oaths of allegiance

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.21 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

sense.def: private possession

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.21 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 27.4.21 (546 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1132; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 995; tr. Legge: 533

tls:text.tls:line: Tsze-p'e then, (as if) by his father's command, presented each family

sense.def: unhusked millet; generally: what is kept in the lín 廩 or cāng 倉 'granaries', grain, cereal

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: with a chung of millet,

sense.def: per family (such-and-such things)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: with a chung of millet,

sense.def: zhong: measure for grain (amount that fills a zhong-vessel)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: thereby winning the attachment of the people;

sense.def: win the trust of; gain the support of; win the allegiance of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: thereby winning the attachment of the people;

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: and in consequence of this the government of the State regularly continued in the hands of the Han family,

sense.def: regularly; invariably; in perpetuity; permanently, constantly

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: and in consequence of this the government of the State regularly continued in the hands of the Han family,

sense.def: ZUO Xiang 29: hold the reins of control over;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: and in consequence of this the government of the State regularly continued in the hands of the Han family,

sense.def: administration of the state

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: and in consequence of this the government of the State regularly continued in the hands of the Han family,

sense.def: administrative power, governmental authority

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: "As we are neighbours to (the State where such) good (is done),

sense.def: be neighbour to N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: our people will expect the same from us."

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: our people will expect the same from us."

sense.def: the object of hope

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: to lend (to the people) out of his public stores of grain,

sense.def: public (benefit, road, law etc), belonging to the public rather than to any private individual

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: to lend (to the people) out of his public stores of grain,

sense.def: lend out

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: and made the great officers all lend in the same way.

sense.def: ensure that someone does something> order someone to do something; dispatch someone to do something

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: and made the great officers all lend in the same way.

sense.def: lend out

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: He himself kept no record of what he lent,

sense.def: lend out

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1026; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: He himself kept no record of what he lent,

sense.def: write the contextually determinate thing down; make a written record of a contextually determinate event

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: The consequence was that none in Sung suffered from want.

sense.def: famished; suffering from famine

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: and the Yoh of Sung.

sense.def: last

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: They two are likely to have the chief sway in their States.

sense.def: win the trust of; gain the support of; win the allegiance of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: The people will be attached to them.

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: The people will be attached to them.

sense.def: rally to (a king or leader), converge on; rally to (a place); turn to, orientate oneself towards (an aim)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.7.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1157; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: But in giving, and not considering it an act of virtue,

sense.def: consider the contextually determinate N as an act of virtue

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: was a daughter of the House of Ke,

sense.def: offspring; product

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: in consequence of which he took the management of the that State.

sense.def: name of a state

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: Che Taou-tsze (Seun Ying) assembled the great officers of the States

sense.def: assemble, call together (the feudal lords), convoke 九合諸侯

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: to fortify its capital.

sense.def: to build a city wall around (an activity either pursued by those in the city or by an expeditionary military force)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: to fortify its capital.

sense.def: name of a state

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: Man Heaou-pih (Chung-sun Keeh) was among them;

sense.def: to to attend (an occasion, a ritual, a meeting)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and from Ch'ing Tsze-t'ae-shuh and Pih-shih (Kung-sun Twan) went.

sense.def: and 吾與汝俱不如也

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and from Ch'ing Tsze-t'ae-shuh and Pih-shih (Kung-sun Twan) went.

sense.def: go to the contextually determinate place (often answering a summoning by a superior)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and spoke with him (about the undertaking).

sense.def: 與之盟/戰

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: that Tsin has no thought about the wants of the States that are connected with the house of Chow,

sense.def: show caring sympathy for N in action

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: that Tsin has no thought about the wants of the States that are connected with the house of Chow,

sense.def: lack, shortage; insufficiency; deficiency; lack of defense; state of indigence or defenselessness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and sets itself to protect this branch of Hea?

sense.def: the Xià dynasty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: But if it abandon them,

sense.def: this

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: But if it abandon them,

sense.def: (unjustifiably) reject (proposals); abandon (a person); jetison; disregard (orders etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: who will remain attached to it?

sense.def: rally to (a king or leader), converge on; rally to (a place); turn to, orientate oneself towards (an aim)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.4 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: I have heard

sense.def: cataphoric: the following object, the object identified further down in the context

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.4 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: that to abandon one's own, and seek to strangers,

sense.def: (unjustifiably) reject (proposals); abandon (a person); jetison; disregard (orders etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.4 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: is a proof of estrangement from virtue.

sense.def: come to commit (a crime); deviate from and thus offend against (virtue, one's ruler etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.4 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: As Tsin does not play a neighbour's part,

sense.def: fail to act as a proper neighbour to neighbours

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.8.4 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1027; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: who will praise it?"

sense.def: speak positively of; have good words for, have anything good to say for

tls:text.tls:srcline: B9.29.9高子容與宋司徒見知伯，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: Kaou Tsze-yung (Kaou Che) of Ts'e and the minister of Instruction of Sung (Hwa Ting), visited Che Pih (Seun Ying),

sense.def: and 吾與汝俱不如也

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: when Joo Ts'e was master of ceremonies.

sense.def: be in charge of, oversee (e.g. a state, or a clan/family)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: when Joo Ts'e was master of ceremonies.

sense.def: descriptive: ritual practices, rituals; ritual; the ceremonies

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: the marshal How (Joo Ts'e) said to Che Pih,

sense.def: speaking to 言於王曰 said to the king ZUO, ZGC, SHIJI, XINLUN

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: "Neither of those gentlemen will escape an evil end.

sense.def: come to a bad end; not escape (an unnatural or violent) death; come to a premature end

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: Tsze-yung is self-sufficient,

sense.def: monopolise power

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and the minister of Instruction is extravagant.

sense.def: extravagant in the use of money; be lavish, be excessive

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1158; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: They are both men who will ruin their families."

sense.def: doomed to ruin 亡國,亡主

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: "Self-sufficiency brings its fate on more rapidly.

sense.def: quickly; fast; as soon as possible

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: but other men deal ruin to self-sufficiency.

sense.def: kill

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.9.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 548

tls:text.tls:line: In this case it will (soon) come."

sense.def: come to pass, ensue, happen

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.10.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: was in acknowledgment of the walling of Ke.

sense.def: offer thanks for by bowing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.10.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1028; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: The duke entertained him,

sense.def: lay on a ceremonial reception (often involving recitation of poetry/songs) for

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: Taou, the marquis's mother, was indignant, and said

sense.def: indignantly, full of indignation

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: that Ts'e (Shuh-how) had taken bribes,

sense.def: bribe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.1 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1159; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and that if their former rulers could know it,

sense.def: if contrary to fact

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and Tsin's greatness is owing to (its absorption of) them.

sense.def: the N therefore V-s

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: If it had not encroached on the small States,

sense.def: If contrary to fact

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: If it had not encroached on the small States,

sense.def: invade, make an incursion into; invasion, incursion; sometimes generally: attack (place or persons, eg 侵我 "attacked us")

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: If it had not encroached on the small States,

sense.def: what is small, something small; specifically refers to: small state

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: where should it have found territory to take?

sense.def: take possession of (a place); annex a state or city; confiscate

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: we have annexed many of them;

sense.def: a lot, much

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and who can call us to account for the encroachments?

sense.def: be able to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: is a remnant of (the House of) Hea,

sense.def: the Xià dynasty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: is a remnant of (the House of) Hea,

sense.def: the rest, the remainder; surplus

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.2 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: and has assimilated to the wild tribes of the east.

sense.def: Eastern Barbarians

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 29.11.3 (544 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1160; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1029; tr. Legge: 549

tls:text.tls:line: are the descendants of the duke of Chow,

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.5 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:162

tls:text.tls:line: But if he has never even mounted a carriage, shot a bow, or driven,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.5 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:162

tls:text.tls:line: How will he have any time to think about the catch?"

sense.def: Whenever? At what time? i.e. never

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.6 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:162

tls:text.tls:line: I have heard that the gentleman strives to understand what is great

sense.def: the person of elevated social status 與野人相對

tls:text.tls:srcline:
小人務知小者、
近者。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.6 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:162

tls:text.tls:line: while the petty man strives to understand what is small and close at hand.

sense.def: petty person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.6 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:162

tls:text.tls:line: a petty man.

sense.def: be just an ordinary person;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.6 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:162

tls:text.tls:line: Robes and garments I wear next to my own body-

sense.def: body as a whole; especially the main trunk as opposed to the head; body as embodying the person

tls:text.tls:srcline:
大官、
大邑、
所以庇身也，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.7 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:162

tls:text.tls:line: But great offices and great cities- though my livelihood depends on them,

sense.def: contrastive: one's own person; oneself; himself

tls:text.tls:srcline: 吾豈敢謂子面如吾面乎？

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.12.9 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1074; tr. Watson 1989:163

tls:text.tls:line: I would not venture to insist that your face be the same as mine.

sense.def: 聲亦如味 be like, look like, act like (what) 何如

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.1 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1193; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1076; tr. Legge: 566

tls:text.tls:line: said to the marquis,

sense.def: speaking to 言於王曰 said to the king ZUO, ZGC, SHIJI, XINLUN

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.2 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1194; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1076; tr. Legge: 566

tls:text.tls:line: And he will be the pattern of the people.'

sense.def: regarding the people, concerning the people; by the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.3 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1194; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 566

tls:text.tls:line: Let him, in whom the people find no pattern,

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.4 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1194; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 566

tls:text.tls:line: "Having majesty that inspires awe, is what we call dignity.

sense.def: be respected, be held in awe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.5 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1194; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 566

tls:text.tls:line: his inferiors fear and love him,

sense.def: [cognate with wēi 威 "authority" fear and revere; stand in awe of 畏天之威

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.7 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1194; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 566

tls:text.tls:line: 'Your friends assisting at the service

sense.def: one's own friend or colleague (of of any kind, singular or plural!)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.8 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1194; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 566

tls:text.tls:line: 'The great states feared his strength,

sense.def: stand in fear of; fear, be very much afraid of and at the same time in awe of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.9 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and on this Chow became afraid, and restored him (to his State).

sense.def: then, thereupon; at that moment

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.9 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and on this Chow became afraid, and restored him (to his State).

sense.def: become frightened; become scared

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.9 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: on his second expedition, (the lord of that State)

sense.def: a second time; for the second time 再取 "marry again" 再。。。再 "over and over again..."

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.10 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: These may be pronounced instances of the awe which he inspired.

sense.def: [cognate with wēi 威 "authority" fear and revere; stand in awe of 畏天之威

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.10 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: his meritorious services with songs and dances,

sense.def: sing, sing about;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.11 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: Therefore when the superior man, occupying a high position, inspires awe;

sense.def: a person of superior character; the person of superior character 得見君子者斯可矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.11 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: Therefore when the superior man, occupying a high position, inspires awe;

sense.def: be respected, be held in awe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.11 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and by his benefice produces love;

sense.def: deserve to be V-ed; merit V-ing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.11 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and all his intercourse with others affords a pattern;

sense.def: deserve to be V-ed; merit V-ing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.11 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and his countenance and steps excite the gaze (of admiration);

sense.def: proper appearance and comportment

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.11 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and his countenance and steps excite the gaze (of admiration);

sense.def: deserve to be V-ed; merit V-ing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.12 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and his voice and air diffuse joy;

sense.def: voice; intonation; the way one sounds

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.12 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and his voice and air diffuse joy;

sense.def: inner mental energies of a person; vital energies in a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: ZUO Xiang 31.13.12 (542 B.C.); Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1195; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n 1077; tr. Legge: 567

tls:text.tls:line: and his words have distinctness and brilliance;-

sense.def: speech; way of talking

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.1 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1199;Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i1; tr. Legge:575

sense.def: 與之盟/戰

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.2 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1199;Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i1; tr. Legge:575

sense.def: find space for, find room for; have enough space for, be large enough for

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.4(541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1200;Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i1; tr. Legge:575

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.4(541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1200;Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i1; tr. Legge:575

sense.def: keep in the dark

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.5(541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1200;Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i1; tr. Legge:575

sense.def: object pronoun, resumptive, non-contrastive: oneself, himself, herself, themselves

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.6(541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1200;Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i1; tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: would it presume to grudge you the use of the temple of the Fung family?"

sense.def: temporary shrine, sometimes specifically for remote ancestors

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.6(541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1200;Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i1; tr. Legge:575

sense.def: container for bows and/or arrows

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.9 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

sense.def: public disgrace, opprobium 雪恥 "wash away a public disgrace"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.9 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: Twice have you assembled the princes of th eStates,

sense.def: twice 再拜

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.10 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: you tranquillized the States of the east;

sense.def: the Chinese;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.10 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

sense.def: 我國家the nation including its leading clans; our nation, my nation, the nation in question, the polity; their nation

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.10 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: the people have uttered no slanders nor revilings;

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.10 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: the people have uttered no slanders nor revilings;

sense.def: slander of any kind

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.10 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: the people have uttered no slanders nor revilings;

sense.def: popular slander, unjustified popular criticism

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.10 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: the people have uttered no slanders nor revilings;

sense.def: backbiting; slanderous talk

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.11 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: and what I am afraid of is,

sense.def: public humiliation, public disgrace; shameful episode

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.12 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1201; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

sense.def: a man of human-heartedness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.13 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1202; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

sense.def: Buddhist: of the same entrance year (in a school or monastery) 年兄

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.14 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1202; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 10i3;tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: 'Not going beyond the right, inflicting no injury,

sense.def: be villainous, commit acts of villainy

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.17 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1203; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1085; tr. Legge:575

tls:text.tls:line: do you find no subject for sorrow

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.17 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1203; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1085; tr. Legge:575

sense.def: give back things

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.18 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1203; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1085; tr. Legge:576

tls:text.tls:line: "If they know it (before-hand),

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.19 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1204; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1085; tr. Legge:576

sense.def: and 吾與汝俱不如也

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.20 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1204; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1086; tr. Legge:576

sense.def: have an impact on; affect, involve, implicate; have an (often bad) influence on; affect

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.21 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1204; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1086; tr. Legge:576

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.1.21 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1204; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1086; tr. Legge:576

tls:text.tls:line: 'What the people desire,

sense.def: the peoople (as endowed with subjective feelings or reactions)

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.2.1 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1204; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1087; tr. Legge:576

sense.def: treat without proper respect

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.2.2 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1205; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1087; tr. Legge:576

tls:text.tls:line: "Why should you grudge

sense.def: contrastive: one's own person; oneself; himself

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.2.3 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1205; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1087; tr. Legge:576

tls:text.tls:line: is for the defence of our altars.

sense.def: our (one's) nation, national ancestral and moral heritage

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.2.4 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1205; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1088; tr. Legge:576

sense.def: to give something to, to confer on; give presents to

sense.def: [cognate with wēi 威 "authority" fear and revere; stand in awe of 畏天之威]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.2.8 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1206; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1088; tr. Legge:577

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.2.8 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1206; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1088; tr. Legge:577

tls:text.tls:line: If they are able for these two things,

sense.def: 是三者

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.13.5 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1224; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1109;; tr. Legge:5i1

tls:text.tls:line: Shuh-heang caused him to recieve the same allowance as the prince ofTs'in,

sense.def: (compared/related etc) with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.13.5 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1224; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1109;; tr. Legge:5i1

tls:text.tls:line: Shuh-heang caused him to recieve the same allowance as the prince ofTs'in,

sense.def: livelihood; level of income, salary in general, on the basis of which one survives; living standards

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.13.7 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1224; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1109;; tr. Legge:5i1

tls:text.tls:line: He does not fear the strong or the powerful,'

sense.def: stand in fear of; fear, be very much afraid of and at the same time in awe of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.13.8 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1224; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1109;; tr. Legge:5i1

tls:text.tls:line: In accordance with this, How-tsze and Tsze-kan were made to take place according to their years.

sense.def: (compared/related etc) with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.14.1 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1225; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1109;; tr. Legge:5i1

tls:text.tls:line: Yew Keih of Ch'ing went to Ts'oo to the funeral of Keah-gaou,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.14.2 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1225; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1109;; tr. Legge:5i1

tls:text.tls:line: and he is delighted with his position.

sense.def: one's own (object) 自多其力 "overestimate one's own strength"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 1.15.1 (541 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1225; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1109;; tr. Legge:5i1

tls:text.tls:line: The earl of Ch'ing was going to Tsin to offer his condolences (on thisevent);

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.2 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1226;W1111; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:text.tls:line: and the Ch'un Ts'ew of Loo,

sense.def: and (conjoining objects) 殺陽令終與其弟完及佗與晉陳及其子弟。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.3 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1227;W1112; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.4 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1227;W1112; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:text.tls:line: It is impossible for me to attain to be like the duke of Shaou."

sense.def: extend to, reach; reach up to the level of; reach out to; reach as far back as to the time of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.6 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1228;W1112; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:text.tls:line: Many of the great officers laughed at these remarks,

sense.def: normally: find ridiculous and laugh at, sneer at

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.6 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1228;W1112; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:text.tls:line: "He

sense.def: this man

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.6 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1228;W1112; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:text.tls:line: is a superior man.

sense.def: be a person of superior character

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.6 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1228;W1112; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:text.tls:line: A superior man is to be believed;

sense.def: a person of superior character; the person of superior character 得見君子者斯可矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.1.6 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1228;W1112; tr. Legge:5i3

tls:text.tls:line: the marquis of which gave him an entertainment.

sense.def: offer food in a ceremonious way to someone; entertain to a banquet[IS THAT THE RIGHT SYN. GROUP SINCE THE WORD USUALLY USUALLY REFERS TO 'ENTERTAIN'; MAYBE IT SHOULD BE MOVED TO 'FEAST'][CA]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.2.1 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1228;W1113; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: In summer, in the fourth month,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.2.2 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1114; tr. Legge:5i4

sense.def: [cognate with wēi 威 "authority" fear and revere; stand in awe of 畏天之威

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.3.1 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1113; tr. Legge:5i4
