sense.def: tremendous, important

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.3.2 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1113; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: "My ruler commissioned me to come here to continue the old friendship (between our States).

sense.def: me, your humble servant (mostly in pivotal constructions:使下臣V)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.3.2 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1113; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: that is my reward.

sense.def: blessings (from Heaven); good fortune

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.3.3 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1113; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: His State is the first consideration with him, and himself the last;

sense.def: read qùshēng: regard as possessed of lesser authority, put last

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.3.3 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1113; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: His State is the first consideration with him, and himself the last;

sense.def: reflexive and contrastive (or sometimes at least emphatic)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.1 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: The Sze and the other great officers wished to put him to death;

sense.def: with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.1 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1229;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: he was afraid he should be too late,

sense.def: be afraid that one might V; be afraid to; be afraid that one V-s

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.2 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and the State cannot endure you.

sense.def: be able to sustain (hardship and trouble); endure bear with, put up with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.3 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: your contention with your cousin about his wife (See the fourth narrative after par.3 of last year)

sense.def: as cousins

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.3 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: how can the State endure you?

sense.def: you

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.4 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

sense.def: boding ill for the future> wicked (and thus boding ill for the future) 凶人

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.5 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:text.tls:line: if he have not,

sense.def: have no particular talents; (by litotes:) be incompetent; be entirely devoid of ability, be devoid of talent

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.4.6 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

sense.def: strangle oneself; commit suicide

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.5.1 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.5.1 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.5.1 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1230;W1115; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 2.5.3 (540 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1231;W1116; tr. Legge:5i4

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.1 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1232: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

tls:text.tls:line: Yew Keih of Ch'ing went to Tsin,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.1 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1232: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.2 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1232: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.2 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1232: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.2 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1232: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

tls:text.tls:line: and to covenant when there were cases of discordant (States to be dealt with).

sense.def: be in harmonious cooperation

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.2 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1232: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

足以昭禮、
命事、
謀闕而已，

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.3 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1232: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.4 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1233: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.5 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1233: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

tls:text.tls:line: but after this you will have nothing to do.

sense.def: however; but

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.5 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1233: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1117; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: the present, the present time; the present age

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.1.6 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1233: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1118; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: people of moral superior character 養君子

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.1 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1233: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: be indefatigable; be unexhausted

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.2 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1233: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: be in dire straights; be in deep trouble

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.2 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1233: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: lose hope

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.3 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1234: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: altars of the land and grain

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.4 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1234: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

tls:text.tls:line: If your lordship, not casting off my poor State,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.4 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1234: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

sense.def: the object of hope

sense.def: our altars of the land and grain; the altars of the land and grain of the subject of the sentence

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.5 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1234: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.5 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1234: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1119; tr. Legge:588

tls:text.tls:line: and comfort Tsin

sense.def: pacify, console

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.6 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1234: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1120; tr. Legge:589

sense.def: in interaction with; in association with; with; in collusion with, in cooperation with (NB: MOVE THE HOSTILE CASES TO THE HOSTILE VARIANT!)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.7 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1234: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1120; tr. Legge:589

tls:text.tls:line: The duke is throwing away his people,

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.9 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1235: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1120; tr. Legge:589

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.10 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1235: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589

tls:text.tls:line: The common people and others groan bitterly (for all this),

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.10 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1235: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589

tls:text.tls:line: The common people and others groan bitterly (for all this),

sense.def: population; the people in general

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.10 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1235: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589

sense.def: some, any

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.10 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1235: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589

sense.def: 堅如石 resemble an N in Vi-ing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.10 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1235: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589

tls:text.tls:line: Though he wished not to win them to himself,

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.12 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1236: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589; revised tr. CH

sense.def: troops; foot-soldier, ordinary infantry soldier 一卒

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.12 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1236: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: when the soldiers are lined up there are no proper superiors.

sense.def: be established in proper order; be lined up in proper order

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.12 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1236: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: when the soldiers are lined up there are no proper superiors.

sense.def: elder, senior; leader

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.12 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1236: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589; revised tr. CH

sense.def: SHI: the multitudinous people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.12 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1236: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589; revised tr. CH

sense.def: buildings; all kinds of buildings, any kind of building

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.12 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1236: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589; revised tr. CH

tls:text.tls:line: while the duke's mansions are multiplied and most costly.

sense.def: keep proliferating

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 3.3.12 (359) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1236: Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.:1121; tr. Legge:589; revised tr. CH

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:text.tls:line: The superior man will say that Shuh-how showed by these remarks that he knew propriety.

tls:text.tls:srcline: 君子謂叔侯於是乎知禮。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:text.tls:line: The superior man will say that Shuh-how showed by these remarks that he knew propriety.

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 5.4.4 (537 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1267; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1154; tr. Legge:605

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 5.4.6 (537 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1267; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1154; tr. Legge:605

sense.def: destruction, ruin

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 5.4.9 (537 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1268; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1155; tr. Legge:605

晉人若喪韓起、
楊肸，

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.4.3 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1277; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1165; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: menial worker employed in a government office; generally: menial subjects, menials

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.5.1 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1277; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1165; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: eunuch

乃坎、
用牲、
埋書，

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.5.2 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1277; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1165; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: with (subject omitted immediately in front of yǔ 與)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.5.2 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1277; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1165; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: eunuch Npr

sense.def: eldest son; most senior person in the generation

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.1 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1278; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1166; tr. Legge:610

tls:text.tls:line: The Kung-tsze K'e-tsih went to Tsin,-

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.2 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1278; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1166; tr. Legge:610

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.2 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1278; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1166; tr. Legge:610

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.3 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1278; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: pull apart, pull open, drag open

sense.def: engage in begging from others

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: is a member of the ruling class 君子也

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.4 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1279; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: person of inferior social status or merely ordinary quality

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.4 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1279; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.5 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1279; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.5 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1279; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: be morally earnest, be morally good and earnest

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.6 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1279; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.7.7 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1279; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.9.1 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1279; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:610

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 6.11.2 (536 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1280; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1167; tr. Legge:611

玉櫝、
斝耳。

tls:text.tls:srcline: 日我先君共王引領北望，

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1285; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1172; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: From that time our ruler king Kung, looked with outstretched neck to the north,

sense.def: stretch out (e.g. crane one's neck)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 日我先君共王引領北望，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1285; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1172; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: From that time our ruler king Kung, looked with outstretched neck to the north,

sense.def: neck as a whole 引領"stretch one's head"

tls:text.tls:srcline: 孤與其二三臣悼心失圖，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1285; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1172; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: and then our ruler and his ministers, in the grief of their hearts, were notable to take proper measures.

sense.def: with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1285; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1172; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: They had not leisure to attend to the business of the altars,

sense.def: our altars of the land and grain; the altars of the land and grain of the subject of the sentence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1286; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1172; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: If now your lordsip will direct your gemmeous steps,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.5 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1286; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1173; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: If your lordship will not come,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.8 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1287; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1173; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: the duke went to Ts'oo.

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.8 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1287; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1173; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: and when they arrived at Ts'oo,

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.3.8 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1287; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1173; tr. Legge:616

tls:text.tls:line: he could not respoond properly at the complimentary meeting in the suburbs.

sense.def: be (temporarily) able to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.4.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1287; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1174; tr. Legge:617

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.4.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1287; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1174; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: "I went," said Wan-pih,"from Wei on to Loo.

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.4.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1287; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1174; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: There will be calamity in the former,

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.4.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1288; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1174; tr. Legge:617

sense.def: archaic: be good

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.4.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1288; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: second, consideration of the people;

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.5.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1288; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: "There is a saying

sense.def: saying, memorable saying; sometimes: proverbial saying, popular saying; bon-mot, dict-on

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.5.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1288; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: and it expresses what is proper.

sense.def: be in accordance with the requirements of ritual

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.5.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1288; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: even you yourself will be suspicious of me."

sense.def: suspicion (ZUO)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.5.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1288; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: I will give you T'aou (instead);-

sense.def: hand over (something N2) to (someone N1), typically as demanded; give (as appropriate under the circumstances, but without having to)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.5.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1288; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: when Ch'ing is got back,

sense.def: return, get back to where one came from; make one's return; flee back

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.6.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: The viscount of Ts'oo entertained the duke in his new tower,

sense.def: offer food in a ceremonious way to someone; entertain to a banquet[IS THAT THE RIGHT SYN. GROUP SINCE THE WORD USUALLY USUALLY REFERS TO 'ENTERTAIN'; MAYBE IT SHOULD BE MOVED TO 'FEAST'][CA]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.6.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: The viscount of Ts'oo entertained the duke in his new tower,

sense.def: new and fashionable; new and neat; newly come into existence (not: new in kind); OBI: newly built (For 新邑 compare "Newcastle" [sorry!])

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.6.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: The viscount of Ts'oo entertained the duke in his new tower,

sense.def: terrace; square platform built on an earth-mound, raised platform 高臺

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.6.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: having a man with a long beard to direct (the ceremonies).

sense.def: GY: long unruly beard (like the mane of a horse) (the word also refers to hair standing on end, according to SHUOWEN)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.6.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: "Ts'e, Tsin, and Yueh," replied K'e-k'eang, "have wished to get this(bow) for a long time.

sense.def: as well as, and in addition

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.6.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: and carefully guard the precious treasure."

sense.def: precious possession; precious things; treasure of high personal, monetary, social or moral value 三寶

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.6.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

sense.def: give back N1 to the contextually determinate N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.7.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1289; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: but his illness has got worse instead of better.

sense.def: cure

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.7.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: which entered in to the abyss of Yu.

sense.def: transform oneself into, turn into

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.7.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1175; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: has perhaps not yet sacrificed to him."

sense.def: very probably, very likely

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: Now he has, unfortunately, died an early death,

sense.def: be in dire straights; be in deep trouble

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1290; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

sense.def: enjoy in practice (profit, benefits)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: "People have the saying,

sense.def: saying, memorable saying; sometimes: proverbial saying, popular saying; bon-mot, dict-on

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: 'The father split the firewood,

sense.def: cut into parts; cut into proper parts

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: 'The father split the firewood,

sense.def: firewood

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

tls:text.tls:line: and the son was not able to carry it.'

sense.def: burden, load (on one's back or shoulder)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 後之人若屬有疆埸之言，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

sense.def: transgression; crime; mistake

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.8.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:617

sense.def: give the determinate object to (a beneficiary)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: The people of Ch'ing frightened one another about Pihh-yew (See on IX.xxx.7),

sense.def: frighten

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

sense.def: OBI: set out for; be on one's way; go along to; go to GUAN: 往之, 所往

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: one man dreamt that Pi-yew walked by him in armour,

sense.def: a certain person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: Tsze-ch'an appointed Kung-sun Seeh (Son of Tsze-k'ung, the Kung-tsze Kea, put to death in the nineteenth year of duke Seang), and Leang Che(Son of Pih-yew), (as the successor of their fathers), in order to soothe thepeople,

sense.def: and [no examples in LY]

tls:text.tls:srcline: 子產立公孫洩及良止以撫之，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1291; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: Tsze-ch'an appointed Kung-sun Seeh (Son of Tsze-k'ung, the Kung-tsze Kea, put to death in the nineteenth year of duke Seang), and Leang Che(Son of Pih-yew), (as the successor of their fathers), in order to soothe thepeople,

sense.def: pacify, console

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.5 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: The administration of government has his proper course;

sense.def: do the contrary, act in a way contrary to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.5 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: they will not obey him."

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.5 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: they will not obey him."

sense.def: show obedience [to one]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.6 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: When Tsze-ch'an went to Tsin,

sense.def: when it came to the point that S, by the time that S, at the point when S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.7 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: They go on in this way, growing in etherealness and brightness, till they become (thoroughly) spiritual and intelligent.

sense.def: realm of the spirits; the deities, the gods; sometimes explicitly: the gods of Heaven and Earth 天地之神明

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.8 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: When an ordinary man or woman dies a violent death,

sense.def: female of marriagable age; 宮婦,室婦

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.8 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: the sould and spirit are still able to keep hanging about men

sense.def: SHI: rely on, cleave to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.8 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: the sould and spirit are still able to keep hanging about men

sense.def: depend on; rely on

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.8 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

sense.def: eldest son by main wife, heir

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.9 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: Although Ch'ing be not great,

sense.def: great abundance of resources

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.9 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: and in fact, as the saying is,

sense.def: however,...

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.9 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: and in fact, as the saying is,

sense.def: proverb

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.9.9 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1292; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1178; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: his use of things had been extensive,

sense.def: tremendous, important

tls:text.tls:srcline: 故馬師氏與子皮氏有惡。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.10.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1179; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: in consequence of which there arose enmity between Ma-sze and Tsze-p'e.

sense.def: (compared/related etc) with

tls:text.tls:srcline: 故馬師氏與子皮氏有惡。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.10.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1179; tr. Legge:618

sense.def: hatred; dislikes (versus likes); bad feelings; hating people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.10.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1179; tr. Legge:618

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.10.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1179; tr. Legge:618

sense.def: escape from; avoid by running away from; run away from, abscond from (difficulties, contracts etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.10.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1179; tr. Legge:618

sense.def: escape, get away; abscond

tls:text.tls:line: One of the great officers of Tsin spoke to Fan Heen-tsze, saying,

sense.def: speaking to 言於王曰 said to the king ZUO, ZGC, SHIJI, XINLUN

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.11.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1293; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

sense.def: rebel

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.11.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

sense.def: then, thereupon; at that moment

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.11.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: if now we go on to show discourtesy to the heir of Wei,

sense.def: heir

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.11.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: and sent Heen-tsze to Wei to offer condolences,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.11.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: and also restored to it the lands of Ts'eih.

sense.def: give back N1 to the contextually determinate N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.11.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: The king sent duke Keen of Ch'ing to Wei to present his condolences,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.11.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: and gave the following expression of his favour to the deceased duke Seang:

sense.def: going after the dead> posthumously; retrospectively 追錫之

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: the duke arrived from Ts'oo.

sense.def: arrive at one's goal; arrive at the place where the speaker is

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: the duke arrived from Ts'oo.

sense.def: OBI 4: from 出自湯谷

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: and set about learning them.

sense.def: aim to learn (a skill); learn to read (a text), recite and understand according to received interpretation (a text); devote oneself to, apply oneself to (cultural studies etc); learn from a teacher about (a subject)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: (Afterwards), when he was about to die,

sense.def: when 及其。。。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: (Afterwards), when he was about to die,

sense.def: be about to; will in the future; be going to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: (Afterwards), when he was about to die,

sense.def: modal particle marking off subordinate temporal clause

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1294; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i1; tr. Legge:618

tls:text.tls:line: he called too him his great officers,

sense.def: summon officially; summon in; call in; deliver a summons (on behalf of a ruler), call in (on behalf of someone else); occasionally with abstract objects 召恥

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: 'When he got the first appointment, he walked with his head bowed down.

sense.def: bow slightly and politely (as when receiving an order from a superior)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: When he got the second, with his shoulders bent;

sense.def: bow deeply (so that one looks like a hunchback)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: when he got the thirdd, with his whole body bent;

sense.def: stoop down; bow down; bow the head 俯而泣, but also ZUO Zhao 7 一命而僂，再命而傴，三命而俯

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: I will have congee in this (boiler);

sense.def: in this place

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: I will have gruel in this (boiler),-

sense.def: in this place

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: to satisfy my hunger (See the prolegomena to vol. IV., par.18).'

sense.def: provide with a simple meal

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: to satisfy my hunger (See the prolegomena to vol. IV., par.18).'

sense.def: my

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.4 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1295; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: to satisfy my hunger (See the prolegomena to vol. IV., par.18).'

sense.def: mouth

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.5 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: (Now), Tsang-sun Heih used to say,

sense.def: saying, memorable saying; sometimes: proverbial saying, popular saying; bon-mot, dict-on

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.5 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: you must put Yueh and Ho-ke under his charge,

sense.def: and 衛侯逐公叔戍與其黨，

tls:text.tls:srcline: 故孟懿子與南宮敬叔師事仲尼。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.6 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: In this way Mang E-tsze (Ho-ke) and Nan-kung Kung-shuh (Yueh) became disciples of Chung-ne.

sense.def: and 吾與汝俱不如也

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.6 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: is a superior man.

sense.def: is a member of the ruling class 君子也

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.12.6 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i2; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: 'The officers have in them a model for imitation.'

sense.def: members of the ruling class; men of superior rank 君子食其味焉

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.14.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: "The six things are not the same.

sense.def: be the same in kind; be identical

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.14.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: People's minds are not one.

sense.def: regarding the people, concerning the people; by the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.14.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: People's minds are not one.

sense.def: be the same

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.14.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: The order of things is not similar.

sense.def: resemble; be similar

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.14.2 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1296; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: How can the verification be constantly calculated on?

sense.def: How can one V?

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.14.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1297; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: 'Some enjoy their ease and rest;

sense.def: some... others (often hard to distinguish from "either... or"); some..., the others

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.14.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1297; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: Some are all-worn in the service of the State.'

sense.def: some... others (often hard to distinguish from "either... or"); some..., the others

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1297; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: but his favourite, Chow-goh, bore to him, first of all, Chih.

sense.def: favourite. Sometimes refers to a concubine, in MENG 1.2.16 refers to a favourite official (acc to Yáng Bójùn)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1297; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: K'ung Ch'ing-tsze dreamt that K'ang-shuh (The first marquis of Wei) toldhim

sense.def: object pronoun, resumptive, non-contrastive: oneself, himself, herself, themselves

tls:text.tls:srcline: 余使羈之孫圉與史苟相之。」

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1297; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: adding,"I will make Ke's grandson Yu, and Sze Kow, his ministers."

sense.def: and (conjoining pivots) 使公子燮與子儀守

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.1 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1297; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 11i4; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: Sze Chaou also dreamt that K'ang-shuh said to him,

sense.def: object pronoun, resumptive, non-contrastive: oneself, himself, herself, themselves

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1298; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1185; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: whether Yuen should enjoy the State of Wei,

sense.def: enjoy the privileges of being a ruler over

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.3 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1298; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1185; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: and preside over its altars;

sense.def: our altars of the land and grain; the altars of the land and grain of the subject of the sentence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.7 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1298; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1185; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: The prince has to preside at the altars,

sense.def: our altars of the land and grain; the altars of the land and grain of the subject of the sentence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 7.15.7 (535 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1298; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1185; tr. Legge:619

tls:text.tls:line: take the charge of the people and officers,

sense.def: population; the people in general

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1300; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: Perhaps it was possessed (by a Spirit).

sense.def: conceivably; probably, quite possibly, in all likelihood; "before you know it"; by any chance

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1300; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: then the people heard wrong.

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1300; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: and discontent and complaints are stirring among the people,

sense.def: resentful slander

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1300; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: and discontent and complaints are stirring among the people,

sense.def: arise, start occurring

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1300; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: and discontent and complaints are stirring among the people,

sense.def: the common people of the contextually determinate place, the native people, the permanently resident people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1300; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: and the strength of the people is tasked to an exhausting degree.

sense.def: regarding the people, concerning the people; by the people

tls:text.tls:srcline: 於是晉侯方築虒祁之宮，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.3 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: At this time the marquis was engaged in building the palace of Tsze-k'e.

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.3 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: "The words of Tsze-yay (The music-master) show him to be a superior man.

sense.def: be gentlemanly; be high-minded 君子哉！; be superior as a person 不亦君子乎; be worthy of a person of superior character

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.3 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: so that they keep enmity far from his own person;

sense.def: contrastive: oneself; the person him/herself 吾身,寡人之身

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.3 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: but the words of a small person

sense.def: petty person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.3 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: so that enmity and blame come upon himself.

sense.def: resentful recrimination

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.4 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: The speakers of them are sure to suffer.

sense.def: person; formal or poetic: his person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.4 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: The speakers of them are sure to suffer.

sense.def: this aforementioned N; the preceding N (is the one the SUBJECT VERBS) 敗是求 "it is defeat that you have sought"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.4 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: The speakers of them are sure to suffer.

sense.def: tire out

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.1.4 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1187; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: The artful speech flows like a stream,

sense.def: be as if one V-s; act as if one V-s; be as if V-ing

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.2.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: The second wife was the favourite,

sense.def: enjoy the special favour of a contextually determinate person N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.2.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: and was entrusted to the care of Shaou, minister of Instruction, and the Kung-tsze Kwo.

sense.def: and 衛侯逐公叔戍與其黨，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.2.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: In summer, in the fourth month, on Sin-hae,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.2.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: duke Gae strangled himself.

sense.def: strangle oneself; commit suicide

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.2.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1301; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: Kan Ching-sze went to Ts'oo to announce (the marquis' death),

sense.def: report a case of death to (a person or a place)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.3.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1302; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: Shuh Kung went to Tsin,

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.3.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1302; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: Yew Keih attended the earl of Ch'in to Tsin,

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.3.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1302; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1189; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: "Most excessive is the delusion you practice on one another.

sense.def: keep in the dark

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.4.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1302; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1190; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: amounted to a thousand.

sense.def: armoured with hardened leather

tls:text.tls:srcline:
逐子成、
子工、
子車，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.5.1 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1302; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1190; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: he drove out Tsze-ch'ing, Tsze.kung, and Tsze-keu,

sense.def: chase away, drive away; banish from one's presence; oust (a ruler etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.5.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1303; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1190; tr. Legge: 622

tls:text.tls:line: "Our young master is grown up.

sense.def: small child, infant; young man

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 8.5.2 (534 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1303; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al. 1190; tr. Legge: 622

sense.def: encounter (difficulties, adversities etc); incur (punishment)

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.4 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: When government is severe, the people are slaughtered.

sense.def: be fierce and dangerous (primarily of animials, then by extension also of generals and men)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.4 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: When government is severe, the people are slaughtered.

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.5 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: 'The people indeed are heavily burdened:-

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.5 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: And so give rest to the four quarters of it;'-

sense.def: to comfort; calm down

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.5 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: In order to make the unconscientious careful,

sense.def: cause to be diligent

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.6 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: 'So may you encourage the distant, and help the near,

sense.def: treat well

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.7 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: When Tsze-ch'an died

sense.def: when it came to the point that S, by the time that S, at the point when S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 20.9.7 (522 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1421; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1306 tr. Legge:6i4

tls:text.tls:line: he shed tears and said,

sense.def: tears (perhaps with an admixture of snivel)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.1.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1423; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1307 tr. Legge:687

tls:text.tls:line: "The king is likely to die from disease of the heart!

sense.def: OBI 5: acute sickness; current state of sickness; also: xīn jí 心疾 "indisposition/illness of the heart/mind"; sickness 斯疾 temporary indisposition; falling sick

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.1.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1423; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1307 tr. Legge:687

tls:text.tls:line: comes within the duties of the son of Heaven.

sense.def: an emperor; the emperor generally (with untensed predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.1.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1424; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1307 tr. Legge:687

tls:text.tls:line: The son of Heaven examines the manners (of the people),

sense.def: the (contextually determinate) Son of Heaven (of the time)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 故和聲入於耳而藏於心，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.1.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1424; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1307 tr. Legge:687

tls:text.tls:line: Hence the harmonious sounds enter the ear, and descend into the heart.

sense.def: sound made by musical instruments

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.1.3 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1424; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1308 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: if they be too large, it cannot bear them.

sense.def: have room for, be able to accomodate

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.1.3 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1424; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1308 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: and the king's heart will not be able to endure it.

sense.def: be able to sustain (hardship and trouble); endure bear with, put up with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.2.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1424; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1308 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: so it will happen to his person."

sense.def: contrastive: himself; oneself; the person him/herself (also: 身雖無能)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.3.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1308 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: In summer,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1309 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: cherishing a hostile feeling to Ch'oo,

sense.def: 與秦戰 with, against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1309 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: whom he slandered to the duke, saying,

sense.def: slander (someone N1) before (someone N2) 譖公于桓公

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1309 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: Death and exile are as determined.

sense.def: death

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1309 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: I must not cause him the loss of another son in the same way."

sense.def: a second time; for the second time 再取 "marry again" 再。。。再 "over and over again..."

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: "If your Grace," said To-leaou, "thus loves the minister of War,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: you had better abandon the State.

sense.def: one must; one should

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: If death can be avoided,

sense.def: be avoided

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1425; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: and instruct him to inform the minister (of what was agitated).

sense.def: inform a (an audience N1) about something determinate N2, report about something determinate to (someone N1); send word to (someone N1)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.3 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: He then took counsel with the duke about driving Ch'oo from the State,

sense.def: with (subject omitted immediately in front of yǔ 與)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.3 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: He then took counsel with the duke about driving Ch'oo from the State,

sense.def: chase away, drive away; banish from one's presence; oust (a ruler etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.4 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: The duke entertained Ch'oo to drink,

sense.def: give (somene N1) (something N2) drink, invite (someone N1) fromally to drink (something N2); give a drinking party for飲鄉人酒

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.4 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: The duke entertained Ch'oo to drink,

sense.def: wine

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.4 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: Chang Kae was surprised at it, and said,

sense.def: be surprised at, find (something) extraordinary

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.5 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: "The minister is old,

sense.def: be of great age; be old and frail; be senior

tls:text.tls:srcline:
遂與子皮、
臼任、
鄭翩殺多僚，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.6 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: and along with Tsze-p'e, K'ew Jiin and Ch'ing Peen, he killed To-leaou.

sense.def: with

tls:text.tls:srcline: 宋城舊鄘及桑林之門而守之。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.4.7 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1310 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: (the duke) repaired the old wall of the city and the gate ofSang-lin, and appointed guards at them.

sense.def: and [no examples in LY]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.5.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1426; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1311 tr. Legge:688

tls:text.tls:line: "What is this for?

sense.def: be what? also: 復是何物？

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.5.3 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1427; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1311 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: At this time Shuh Cheh wept because of the eclipse of the sun.

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1427; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: Hwa Tang came with an army of Woo, to relieve the Hwas.

sense.def: the army of the contextually determinate N; army; OBI: military camp, encampment. Troops, armed force, division of the armed forces, regular armed forces; (obsolescent after Qin) HF 1.2: (several hundred thousand) organised armed personnel (should probably be npost-N)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1427; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: "We find in the 'Art of War',

sense.def: military (law, equipment) 軍志 "military records"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1427; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: "We find in the 'Art of War',

sense.def: cataphoric: the following object, the object identified further down in the context

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1427; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: If they enter (the city) and establish themselves,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.3 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1427; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: "A small man like myself

sense.def: be just an ordinary person;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.3 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1427; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: He then sent round (the city) saying,

sense.def: announce 徇曰

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.4 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: it will be a disgrace to your,

sense.def: public disgrace, opprobium 雪恥 "wash away a public disgrace"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.5 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: with which he ran about,

sense.def: bear over one's shoulder (sometimes written 何 in early texts)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.7 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: they fought with the Hwas at Chay-k'ew.

sense.def: 與秦戰 with, against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.8 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: Kan Ch'ow drove Hwa P'aou warden of Leu,

sense.def: border guard, border warden

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.8 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: and Shing was withdrawing,

sense.def: turn round; be on one's way back; having turned back (and being thus on one's way back)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.9 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: "May the powerful influence of duke P'ing

sense.def: magical effectiveness, supernatural efficiency; divine influence; divinely aided succour

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.9 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: (now) assist me!"

sense.def: would that

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.10 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: Chang Kae took his spear, and descended from the chariot.

sense.def: pull out so as to use 抽刀 "pull a dagger", also 抽戈 "pull out a lance (presumably from a stand, in preparation for using it)"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.10 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: Chang Kae took his spear, and descended from the chariot.

sense.def: official baton or lance, a ritual weapon

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.10 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: brought his thigh,

sense.def: break off; take off (an ear); have (one's ribs etc) broken

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.10 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1428; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1312 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: brought his thigh,

sense.def: thigh

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.12 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: Hwa Hae beat his breast and cried out.

sense.def: clap against, tap on (one's thighs), beat against so as to produce a sound

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.12 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: Hwa Hae beat his breast and cried out.

sense.def: chest

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.12 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: Hwa Hae beat his breast and cried out.

sense.def: call out, shout

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.6.13 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: They then sent Hwa Tang to Ts'oo to ask assistance.

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.7.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: If you do not anticipate the king's wishes,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.7.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: and the viscount was about to punish Ts'ae,

sense.def: launch an official or overt punitive expedition against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.7.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: "The marquis P'ing had a covenant with Ts'oo,

sense.def: in interaction with; in association with; with; in collusion with, in cooperation with (NB: MOVE THE HOSTILE CASES TO THE HOSTILE VARIANT!)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.7.2 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1429; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: and therefore he was raised to the State.

sense.def: be enfeoffed; receive a fief

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.8.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1431; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: The duke was going to Tsin;

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 21.8.1 (521 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1431; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1313 tr. Legge:689

tls:text.tls:line: but when he arrived at the Ho,

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 22.1.2(520 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1432; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1317 tr. Legge:692

tls:text.tls:line: In consequence of all this Keu conceived a great hatred of its

sense.def: from then on

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 22.2.1 (520 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1433; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1317 tr. Legge:692

tls:text.tls:line: Wei Yueh of Ts'oo sent a message to (the duke of) Sung, saying,

sense.def: pass on a message to (somebody), (saying:)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 22.2.1 (520 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1433; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1317 tr. Legge:692

tls:text.tls:line: "From my want of ability

sense.def: display shrewd eloquence; have shrewd eloquence 寡人不佞

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 22.2.1 (520 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1433; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1317 tr. Legge:692

tls:text.tls:line: I was not able to love my uncles and elder brothers,

sense.def: (manage to) please through an affable appearance, curry favour with; beguile

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 22.2.2 (520 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1433; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1317 tr. Legge:692

tls:text.tls:line: But people have a saying,

sense.def: saying, memorable saying; sometimes: proverbial saying, popular saying; bon-mot, dict-on

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 22.2.3 (520 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1433; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1317 tr. Legge:692

tls:text.tls:line: If your ruler vouchsafe his kind protection to my poor State,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 22.2.3 (520 B.C) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1433; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1317 tr. Legge:692

tls:text.tls:line: its is my hope that he will not give honour to the worthless,

sense.def: be morally earnest, be morally good and earnest

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.4 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

tls:text.tls:line: (the princes, their relatives) would succour and save them.

sense.def: succour, come to the aid of; save from (e.g. punishment); occasionally: aid and abet

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.4 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

tls:text.tls:line: (the princes, their relatives) would succour and save them.

sense.def: come to (someone's) aid, come to the rescue of, support someone in adversity

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.5 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: body as a whole; especially the main trunk as opposed to the head; body as embodying the person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.5 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: pray for

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.5 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: life-time; personal survival; one's life as an individual (as someting one might lose, or which might be endangered)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.5 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

tls:text.tls:line: proved stubborn and tyrannical,

sense.def: be reckless, be callous and cruel; be violent; make violent and abrupt movements

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.5 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

tls:text.tls:line: proved stubborn and tyrannical,

sense.def: be cruel

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.5 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

tls:text.tls:line: but the myriads of the people could not bear (to hurt him)

sense.def: the common people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.5 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1475; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.7 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1476; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: heir

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.7 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1476; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

tls:text.tls:srcline:
則有晉、
鄭咸黜不端，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.8 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1476; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: then, at that time specified in the preceding (often minor) sentence

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.8 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1476; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: to comfort; calm down

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.8 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1476; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1361 tr. Legge:717

sense.def: And this (is of the Nab type)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.12 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1477; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.12 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1477; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: give generous support; (often said of Heaven) give succour to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.12 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1477; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.13 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1478; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: hide in/at

tls:text.tls:srcline: 若我一二兄弟甥舅獎順天法，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.13 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1478; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.13 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1478; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

tls:text.tls:line: and not assist those cunning knaves,

sense.def: swindler; those who are wily

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.13 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1478; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

tls:text.tls:line: and not assist those cunning knaves,

sense.def: those who are crafty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.13 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1478; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: acquit??

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.14 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1478; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: and [no examples in LY]

tls:text.tls:srcline: 穆后及大子壽早夭即世，

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.9.15 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1478; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1362 tr. Legge:718

tls:text.tls:srcline: 穆后及大子壽早夭即世，

sense.def: die

tls:text.tls:line: There is no uncertainty in the ways of Heaven;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.10.2 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1479; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1365 tr. Legge:718

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.10.3 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1479; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1365 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: and

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.10.3 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1479; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1365 tr. Legge:718

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.2 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.2 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

sense.def: with 相與食

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.6 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

tls:text.tls:line: the husband be harmonious and the wife gentle,

sense.def: a husband in general;

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.6 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.6 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.6 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

tls:text.tls:line: the mother-in-law be kind and the daughter-in-law obedient;-

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.6 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.7 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

tls:text.tls:srcline:
「夫禮、
先王所稟於天地以為其民也，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 26.11.8 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1480; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1366 tr. Legge:718

sense.def: the people

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 27.1.1 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 14i2; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1368 tr. Legge:721

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 27.2.2 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 14i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1368 tr. Legge:721

tls:text.tls:srcline: 令尹子常以舟師及沙汭而還。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 27.2.2 (516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 14i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1368 tr. Legge:721

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 27.2.3(516 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 14i3; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1368 tr. Legge:721
