tls:text.tls:line: and the duke was going to have a coffin made for it,

sense.def: temporary small coffin in which battle dead are transported home

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.3.2 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1499; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1387 tr. Legge:730

tls:text.tls:line: On this he had it wrapped up in a curtain, (and buried it).

sense.def: (wrap) in a curtain

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.3.2 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1499; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1387 tr. Legge:730

tls:text.tls:line: On this he had it wrapped up in a curtain, (and buried it).

sense.def: wrap up

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.3.3 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1500 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1387 tr. Legge:730

tls:text.tls:line: and gave him (the city of) Yang-kuh.

sense.def: hand over (something N2) to (someone N1), typically as demanded; give (as appropriate under the circumstances, but without having to)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.3.4 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1500 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1387 tr. Legge:730

tls:text.tls:line: "We retired here together.

sense.def: with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.2 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1500 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: "I have heard myself

sense.def: 是四國者

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.4 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: He was (also) invested with (the principality of) Tsung-ch'uen,

sense.def: enfeof N1 in N2 於x or 以x

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.4 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: We come (then) to K'ung-keah of the Hea dynasty,

sense.def: when it came to the point that S, by the time that S, at the point when S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.4 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: We come (then) to K'ung-keah of the Hea dynasty,

sense.def: the Xià dynasty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: was a descendant called Lew Luy,

sense.def: offspring, later generations

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: who had learned (studied CH) the art of rearing dragons from the family of Hwan-lung.

sense.def: study (some skill N1) with (a master N2), study ( a subject N1) under (a master N2) 學於孔子

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: and was able to feed the dragons.

sense.def: give something to eat to (a person or sometimes an animal); provide for the subsistene of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: and was able to feed the dragons.

sense.def: give something to drink (also to horses and dragons)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: The sovereign esteemed his service,

sense.def: the Xià dynasty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: The sovereign esteemed his service,

sense.def: esteem highly; experience as exquisite, find exquisiste; appreciate as exquisite

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: gave him the clan-name of Yu-lung,

sense.def: give a contextually determinate thing N1 to (a recipient N2);

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: and appointed him to the place of the descendants of Ch'e-wei (See on IX.xxiv.1).

sense.def: offspring, later generations

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.6 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: and he secretly preserved it as minced meat in brind, supplying with it the table of the sovereign of Hea

sense.def: the Xià dynasty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.6 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1501 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: who enjoyed it,

sense.def: the Xià dynasty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.7 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1502 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: morning and evening thinking of them,

sense.def: at short intervals, all the time; day and night

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.8 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1502 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: If they neglect and abandon those duties,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.8 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1502 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: If they neglect and abandon those duties,

sense.def: eliminate destroy

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.8 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1502 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: and were appointed dukes of the highest rank.

sense.def: enfeof (someone determinate N1) to become an N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.8 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1502 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: and received honour and offerings,

sense.def: our altars of the land and grain; the altars of the land and grain of the subject of the sentence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.9 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1502 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1389 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: (consider) what we have in the Yih of Chow.

sense.def: cataphoric: the following object, the object identified further down in the context

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.11 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1503 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1390 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: If the dragon had not constantly-morning and evening-appeared,

sense.def: If contrary to fact

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.11 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1503 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1390 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: If the dragon had not constantly-morning and evening-appeared,

sense.def: at short intervals, all the time; day and night

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.11 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1503 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1390 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: "What were the families of the five officers,

sense.def: our altars of the land and grain; the altars of the land and grain of the subject of the sentence

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.12 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1503 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1390 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: and Sew and He, Heuen-ming.

sense.def: and

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.4.14 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1503 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1390 tr. Legge:731

tls:text.tls:line: During the Hea dynasty and previously they sacrificed to him.

sense.def: the Xià dynasty

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.5.2 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1504 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1393 tr. Legge:732

tls:text.tls:line: the people would be able to honour their higher classes,

sense.def: the people (with non-agentive predicate)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.5.2 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1504 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1393 tr. Legge:732

tls:text.tls:line: the people would be able to honour their higher classes,

sense.def: the N therefore V-s

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.5.2 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1504 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1393 tr. Legge:732

tls:text.tls:line: and those highter clases would be able to preserve their inheritances.

sense.def: the N therefore V-s

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.5.3 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1504 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1393 tr. Legge:732

tls:text.tls:line: the people will study the tripods,

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.5.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1505 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1393 tr. Legge:732

tls:text.tls:line: If he cultivate his virtue,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 29.5.5 (514 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1505 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1393 tr. Legge:732

tls:text.tls:line: If he cultivate his virtue,

sense.def: act virtuously; comport oneself well

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.1.1 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1505 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

sense.def: and 衛侯逐公叔戍與其黨，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.1 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.1 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: Wei Heen-tsze sent Sze King-pih to question him,

sense.def: interrogate thoroughly

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.3 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: lies in the rules of propriety,

sense.def: be in accordance with the requirements of ritual

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.3 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: by which

sense.def: marker of topics to be discussed in general abstract terms: as for N as such (Note that the comment is never narrative: one might say that this topic marker, like 夫 has a modal function.)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.3 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: we perform our duties and render our contributions.

sense.def: tribute

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.4 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: that, on the death of the prince of a State,

sense.def: a feudal lord; occasionally also count noun: feudal lord, as in SHIJI: 漢王部五諸侯兵 "the king of Han lead the armed forces of five feudal lords"

tls:text.tls:srcline:
唯嘉好、
聘享、
三軍之事於是乎使卿。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.4 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: Only on occasions of marriage, friendly alliances,complimentary missioons, and offerings was a minister to be sent.

sense.def: N then V-ed; N thus V-ed

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.5 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: when there was leisure in our poor State,

sense.def: be unengaged in irrelevant duties; be free and easy; feel at ease, feel at leisure

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.5 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: If there was no leisure (from existing affairs),

sense.def: if by any chance; if on the other hand GY: 若其予之 若其有知 "if they have awareness"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.5 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1506 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: If there was no leisure (from existing affairs),

sense.def: be unengaged in irrelevant duties; be free and easy; feel at ease, feel at leisure

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.6 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1507 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1395 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: and did not condemn where they were deficient,

sense.def: fail to deliver what is expected

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.2.7 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1507 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1394 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: The people of Tsin could not question him any further.

sense.def: keep asking more detailed questions

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.1 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1507 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: The viscount of that State made them a large grant of land,

sense.def: give a feof to contextually determinate persons

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.2 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: "Kwang of Woo has lately got that State,

sense.def: newly, recently; lately; just

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.2 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: He regarrds them as his sons,

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.2 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: He regarrds them as his sons,

sense.def: 養民如子 like (comparison being with the V-ing of N2, the object of the preceding transitive verb with the V-ing of N1)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.3 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: If we were to cultivate good relations with the borders of Woo,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.3 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: but we go and give territory to its enemies,

sense.def: arch enemy, foe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.4 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: and may be compared with one of the States of the kingdom.

sense.def: the various Chinese states

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.4 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1396 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: and will wish to pursue a similar course to the former kings.

sense.def: cause (oneself) to be the same as N2> emulate N2

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.6 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: He raised embankments on the hills so as to lay the capital under water

sense.def: to flood (a city etc), to inundate

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.7 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: who condoled with him and sent him away,

sense.def: offer formal consolation on the occasion of a serious disaster of some kind

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.3.7 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1508 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:734

tls:text.tls:line: but he did not arrive in time;

sense.def: be in time (and of avail)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.4.2 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1509 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:735

tls:text.tls:line: "The government of Ts'oo is in the hands of many, who are at variance among themselves,

sense.def: contrary, perverse; be at odds with each other; be at loggerheads

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.4.2 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1509 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:735

tls:text.tls:line: and not one of them could bear the burden of calamity.

sense.def: have the heart to live with, be able to bear ZUO Cheng 3.4 臣不任受怨，君亦不任受德。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.4.2 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1509 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:735

tls:text.tls:line: If we form three armies to harass it,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.4.3 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1509 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:735

tls:text.tls:line: leading it wrong also in many ways,

sense.def: cheat, delude, mislead

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 30.4.3 (512 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1509 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1397 tr. Legge:735

tls:text.tls:line: and Ts'oo thus began to be distressed.

sense.def: N then V-ed; N thus V-ed

tls:text.tls:srcline: 季孫意如會晉荀躒于適歷。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 31.2.2 (511 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1510 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1399 tr. Legge:737

tls:text.tls:line: When they met as described in the text,

sense.def: go to (a place, typically on some mission of importance); walk up to a person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 31.2.3 (511 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1511 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1399 tr. Legge:737

tls:text.tls:line: and I will not presume to flee from the punishment which he may order.

sense.def: escape from; avoid by running away from; run away from, abscond from (difficulties, contracts etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 31.2.3 (511 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1511 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1399 tr. Legge:737

tls:text.tls:line: If he considers that I am chargeable with guilt,

sense.def: if

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Zhao 31.2.4 (511 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1511 Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1399 tr. Legge:737

tls:text.tls:line: If out of regard to my fathers,

tls:text.tls:line: The prince of Wei prayed, saying,

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.10 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1494; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: "I, Kwae-wae, your distant descendant, venture to announce to you king Wan, my great ancestor,

tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.11 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1494; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: is not able to deal with and bring to order.

sense.def: control (perhaps prototypically water and rivers; breath, emotions, or the mind), order properly, deal with efficiently

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.11 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1494; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: is not able to deal with and bring to order.

sense.def: confused unruliness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.11 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1494; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: He has now sent Yang to punish them,

sense.def: seek out and punish; punish (for an offence); launch a punitive attack on

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.11 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1494; tr. Legge:799

sense.def: give (oneself) peace

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.11 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1494; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: am here with my spear in my hand.

sense.def: hold and carry, take along; carry along; support with one's hands

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.11 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1494; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: am here with my spear in my hand.

sense.def: spear, lance

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.12 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1495; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: I do not presume to announce this to you, and pray that my sinews may not be injured,

sense.def: break off; snap

tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.12 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1495; tr. Legge:799

sense.def: break off; take off (an ear); have (one's ribs etc) broken

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.12 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1495; tr. Legge:799

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.12 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1495; tr. Legge:799

tls:text.tls:line: and you my ancestors may not be disgraced.

sense.def: set up, originate (something), create, invent; produce; of texts: compose

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.12 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1495; tr. Legge:799

tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 2.3.12 (493 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1616; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1495; tr. Legge:799

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)

姚、般、
公孫林殿而射，

tls:text.tls:line: If (Loo) may in the summer covenant with you in Tsang-yen,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 7.5.1 (488 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1644; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1519; tr. Legge:i14

tls:text.tls:line: A body of men from Sung laid siege to (the capital of) Ts'aou.

sense.def: in Annals cancellary style: (unidentified) patricians of Npl; the leadership of Npl; often: an (unidentified) representative of Npl; representatives of Npl, sometimes military: the (military) men from Npl, the forces of Npl

tls:text.tls:srcline: 曹人或夢眾君子立于社宮，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 7.5.2 (488 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1644; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1519; tr. Legge:i14

tls:text.tls:line: a man of Ts'aou dreamt that a number of gentlemen were standing in the temple (adjoining the) altar of the land,

sense.def: a certain npro belonging to the category N [many examples of SOME need to be moved here!CH]; certain such npros

tls:text.tls:srcline: 曹人或夢眾君子立于社宮，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 7.5.2 (488 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1644; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1519; tr. Legge:i14

tls:text.tls:line: a man of Ts'aou dreamt that a number of gentlemen were standing in the temple (adjoining the) altar of the land,

sense.def: members of the ruling class; men of superior rank 君子食其味焉

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 7.5.3 (488 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1644; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1519; tr. Legge:i14

tls:text.tls:line: When Yang became earl of Ts'aou,

sense.def: when it came to the point that S, by the time that S, at the point when S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 7.5.5 (488 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1645; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1519; tr. Legge:i14

tls:text.tls:line: The people of Sung invaded the State,

sense.def: in Annals cancellary style: (unidentified) patricians of Npl; the leadership of Npl; often: an (unidentified) representative of Npl; representatives of Npl, sometimes military: the (military) men from Npl, the forces of Npl

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.1.1 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1646; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: the duke fo Sung attacked (the capital of) Ts'aou, and was withdrawing,

sense.def: make an about turn and withdraw, turn back, head back; turn round in order to withdraw or return to where one comes from, or retrace one's steps

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.1.1 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1646; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: while Tsze-fei, superintendent of the market-place, was bringing up the rear.

sense.def: to defend the rear; guard the rear

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.1.1 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1646; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: Him the people of Ts'aou reviled so much

sense.def: vilify, revile and humiliate noisily; curse (Heaven etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.1.1 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1646; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: and ordered the troops to return to the attack.

sense.def: counterattack

tls:text.tls:srcline: 執曹伯陽及司城彊以歸，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.1.2 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1646; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: laid hold of the earl and K'eang the minister of Works, carried themback with him to Sung,

sense.def: and [no examples in LY]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.1 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: "Loo has the name (of being a great State), but no the reality.

sense.def: real facts of a matter, real state of affairs; real facts of a case

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.2 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: When a superior man leaves his own State,

sense.def: a person of superior character; the person of superior character 得見君子者斯可矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.2 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: When a superior man leaves his own State,

sense.def: offend against the rules of proper behaviour

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.2 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: he does not go to one that is in enmity with it.

sense.def: go to and get to a certain place; be on one's way to a certain place, head for

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.2 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: he does not go to one that is in enmity with it.

sense.def: with whom one has a feud

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.2 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i16

tls:text.tls:line: he may hurry away to do it service,

sense.def: work with due diligence and haste; follow one's instructions in all haste

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.3 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: because of his (private) animosities;

sense.def: reject, dismiss; disregard, fail to obey (orders); discard; eliminate, remove

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.3 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: because of his (private) animosities;

sense.def: the home area of a contextually determinate person LY 17.11, 13.25, 13.24: larger local community not in the capital but not necessarily too far from it; local neighbourhood; compare also the different CC 305: home

tls:text.tls:srcline:
今子以小惡而欲覆宗國，
不亦難乎？

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.3 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and is it not a hard case that you, on account of a small animosity, should wish to overturn the State of your ancestors?

sense.def: destroy

tls:text.tls:srcline:
今子以小惡而欲覆宗國，
不亦難乎？

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.3 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and is it not a hard case that you, on account of a small animosity, should wish to overturn the State of your ancestors?

sense.def: ancestral

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.3 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: If they (wish) you to lead the way for them,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.3 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: you must refuse,

sense.def: decline the offer, decline the honour; refuse the request

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.3 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and the king will then employ me."

sense.def: be about to; will in the future; be going to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.4 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: Tsin, Ts'e, and Ts'oo will help it,

sense.def: with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.4 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: Tsin, Ts'e, and Ts'oo will help it,

sense.def: to help; be of use to; to support (normally rulers, but occasionally wicked persons or practices); to assist (the exercise of proper government)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.4 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and you will have four enemies to contend with.

sense.def: 是三臣

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.4 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1520; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and you will have four enemies to contend with.

sense.def: arch enemy, foe

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.5 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: as it were the lips of Ts'e and Tsin.

sense.def: the "lips"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.5 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: If the lips are destroyed, the teeth get cold,-

sense.def: (normally human or equine etc) front teeth, tooth

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.5 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1647; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: If the lips are destroyed, the teeth get cold,-

sense.def: be cold (of persons), go cold; fresh and chilly; be cold (as winter)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.6 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: Tsze-seeh acting as guide to it

sense.def: guide the contextually determinate person or group

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.6 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and purposely leading (its army) by the most difficult path

sense.def: inaccessible territory

tls:text.tls:srcline: 武城人或有因於吳竟田焉，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.6 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: some men of that city had been taking the opportunity to hunt on the borders of Woo,

sense.def: a certain npro belonging to the category N [many examples of SOME need to be moved here!CH]; certain such npros

tls:text.tls:srcline: 武城人或有因於吳竟田焉，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.6 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: some men of that city had been taking the opportunity to hunt on the borders of Woo,

sense.def: go on an official hunt, sometimes specifically the spring hunt

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.7 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: When the army (of Woo) now arrived (in the neighbourhood),

sense.def: when it came to the point that S, by the time that S, at the point when S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.7 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: the man who had been caught showed it the way to attack the city,

sense.def: be arrested

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.7 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and the people of the State were afraid of him, (thinking he might have delivered the city of Woo).

sense.def: a person entitled to ride in a wheeled vehicle, in particular a war chariot, as a citizen of senior status

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.7 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and the people of the State were afraid of him, (thinking he might have delivered the city of Woo).

sense.def: be afraid of the contextually determinate N

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.8 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: we must at once fight with it.

sense.def: at that point in time [Clear examples need to be moved here.]

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.8 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: we must at once fight with it.

sense.def: 與之盟/戰

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.8 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: we must at once fight with it.

sense.def: fight against

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.8 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: it halted at Woo-woo.

sense.def: take temporary lodging (with somebody or in a certain place); (of army) encamp at

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.9 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1648; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

sense.def: with him, with them, etc. 與戰fought a battle with him, 與知: Greek suneidein "be co-aware of"

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: the army advanced to Kang-tsung,

sense.def: take temporary lodging (with somebody or in a certain place); (of army) encamp at

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and halted at Sze-shang.

sense.def: make a halt in; spend some days in

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: There We Hoo wanted to attack the encampment at night,

sense.def: during THAT night

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: There We Hoo wanted to attack the encampment at night,

sense.def: dwelling; humble home; often used by guests only for a night or two; temporary hut; humble designation of one's own home; also abstract: place to assemble and exist in; encampment (of army)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 私屬徒七百人三踊於幕庭，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and privately collected seven hundred footmen who he proved by making them take three jumps in the court before his tent,

sense.def: unofficially, in a non-official way; for one's own personal purposes; in a way not defined by one's public obligations; in an unlicenced way,unofficially, personally, in an unauthorised way; privately and not on an official public occasion

tls:text.tls:srcline: 私屬徒七百人三踊於幕庭，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and privately collected seven hundred footmen who he proved by making them take three jumps in the court before his tent,

sense.def: to assemble (of people), to call together

tls:text.tls:srcline: 私屬徒七百人三踊於幕庭，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and privately collected seven hundred footmen who he proved by making them take three jumps in the court before his tent,

sense.def: SHI: jump up; LIJI: jump up as sign of extreme mourning stump the ground; leap about

tls:text.tls:srcline: 私屬徒七百人三踊於幕庭，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

sense.def: (often military) tent with a roof which serves as living quarters; main tent used by the general on a campaign

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.10 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: among whom was Yew Joh (One of Confucius's disciples).

sense.def: attend (e.g. meetings); join (e.g. people)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.11 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: When they had arrived inside the Tseih gate,

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.11 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: some one said to Ke-sun,

sense.def: a certain person

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.11 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and we shall lose many officers by the attempt.

sense.def: many of the object N; much of the object stuff

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.11 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and we shall lose many officers by the attempt.

sense.def: a distinguished gentleman of state; state hero

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.11 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: It had better not be made."

sense.def: had better, should ideally, should under the circumstances, should given the alternatives that the situation presents

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.11 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: It had better not be made."

sense.def: desist, give it a break; stop at a certain point, leave it at that, leave things as they are and do nothing about them

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.12 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: the people exchanged their children and ate them,

sense.def: to exchange one thing for another, swap; possibly with the underlying implication that there are only two possibilities in question

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.12 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: the people exchanged their children and ate them,

sense.def: eat the contextually determinate substance

tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 8.2.12 (487 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1649; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1521; tr. Legge:i17

tls:text.tls:line: and cleave the bones for fuel;

sense.def: cut into parts; cut into proper parts

sense.def: 其夏

tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.1.1 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1727; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: He is sure to vent his poison on the people,

sense.def: the people

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.1.2 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1728; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: (On this, the marquis) dug up the grave of Ting-tsze, superintendent of the markets,

sense.def: dig out; dig the ground for (medicinal roots etc); dig (a pond etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.1.2 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1728; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: (On this, the marquis) dug up the grave of Ting-tsze, superintendent of the markets,

sense.def: grave; specifically: subterranean part of the tomb (on top of which trees may grow)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.1.2 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1728; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: and burned his body on the top of P'ing-chwang.

sense.def: burn up, burn down; set fire to; scorch

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.1.5 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1728; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: They then sent great bribes to the officers of Yueh,

sense.def: bribe; bribe (e.g. yǐ 以 "with" precious objects, workers, or fine horses); give bribes to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.1.5 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1728; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: and, the armies withdrawing,

sense.def: the army of the contextually determinate N; army; OBI: military camp, encampment. Troops, armed force, division of the armed forces, regular armed forces; (obsolescent after Qin) HF 1.2: (several hundred thousand) organised armed personnel (should probably be npost-N)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.1.5 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1728; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: and, the armies withdrawing,

sense.def: make an about turn and withdraw, turn back, head back; turn round in order to withdraw or return to where one comes from, or retrace one's steps

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.1 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1729; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1602; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: At this time Hwang Hwan was master of the Right;

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.3 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1729; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: the duke was taking relaxation by the marsh of K'ung;

sense.def: wander about; be on a pleasure trip; take a pleasure trip; roam freely

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.3 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1729; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: and conveyed the duke's (body) from K'ung-t'ung to the capital. Having gone with it to the Yuh palace,

sense.def: go to N in order to V

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.4 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1730; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: "The ruler is very ill,

sense.def: suffer from a serious illness

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.4 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1730; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: and accordingly they covenanted in the courtyard of the small chamber,

sense.def: living quarters; building with bedrooms; private chambers; imposing building with inner chambers

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.5 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1730; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: that Ta-yin had deceived the ruler

sense.def: cause to become confused; cause to be confused

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.5 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1730; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: that Ta-yin had deceived the ruler

sense.def: bewitch and thereby deceive; keep in a state of delusion

tls:text.tls:srcline: 得夢啟北首而寢於盧門之外，

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.6 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1730; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: Tih dreamt that K'e was lying outside the Loo gate with his head to the north,

sense.def: lie in bed; stay in bed; keep in bed

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.6 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1730; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: and that he himself was a bird which was settled upon him.

sense.def: object pronoun, resumptive, non-contrastive: oneself, himself, herself, themselves

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.7 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: Ta-yin then considered

sense.def: (inner monologue:) say to oneself that S; think that S 謀曰

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.7 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: and they might drive him out,

sense.def: chase away, drive away; banish from one's presence; oust (a ruler etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.8 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: whether they could not get the people

sense.def: the people (as subjects of action)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.8 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: to drive him out for them.

sense.def: chase away, drive away; banish from one's presence; oust (a ruler etc)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.8 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: sending notice round the city to this effect,

sense.def: proclaim to 徇於師: S

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.8 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: "Ta-yin keeps the ruler in a State of delusion,

sense.def: bewitch and thereby deceive; keep in a state of delusion

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.8 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: Those who side with us

sense.def: be on theside of; associate with, cooperate with, have dealings with; join in with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.9 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: "Let us side with them."

sense.def: be on theside of; associate with, cooperate with, have dealings with; join in with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.9 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: Ta-yin, (on his part), sent round a notice, saying,

sense.def: announce 徇曰

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.9 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1604; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: Those who side with me

sense.def: be on theside of; associate with, cooperate with, have dealings with; join in with

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.2.10 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1605; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: "It is not different (from a ducal notice)!"

sense.def: discern; differentiate between; to treat as separate, to hold apart, make the distinction between

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.3.1 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1731; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1605; tr. Legge:859

tls:text.tls:line: "I do not know."

sense.def: I, your servant (not necessarily minister or even official); I your son(!!!)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.3.3 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1732; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1605; tr. Legge:860

tls:text.tls:line: I do not know by what means he is to re-enter.

sense.def: recognise that S is the case; be aware that S happened

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 26.3.3 (470 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1732; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1605; tr. Legge:860

tls:text.tls:line: If he (only) had the men,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.1.1 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1732; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1607; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: that the boundary between it and Loo should be T'ae-shang.

sense.def: make a boundary at

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.1.2 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1733; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1607; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: "If he had been here,

sense.def: If contrary to fact

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.2.1 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1733; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1607; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: In summer, in the fourth month, on Ke-hae,

sense.def: in the summer (of the contextually determinate year) NB: when followed, as often, by 四月 the reference is to the fourth month of the lunar year, NOT of the summer.

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.3 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: When he arrived at Lew-shoo,

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.3 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: When he got to the Puh,

sense.def: arrive at (a place); surprisingly often introducing subjectless subordinate temporal clause as a vtadS: (when the subject) got to (a place); get as far as; get close to, get close enough to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.4 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: and I am afraid it will not be in time."

sense.def: be in time (and of avail)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.4 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: stood upon the bank,

sense.def: slope

tls:text.tls:srcline:
馬不出者，
助之鞭之。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.4 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: and now helped forward, now whipt on, the horses which were unwilling to proceed.

sense.def: to whip; to have (someone) whipped; whip a body part

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.5 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: My ruler therefore sent me to examine into the justice of (the fate of) Ch'in,

sense.def: earnestness; sincerity of the heart; moral sincerity; moral earnestness;; moral seriousness; a moral sense

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.6 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: If you consider that the overthrow of your root is an advantage to you,

sense.def: if; or if (often with implicit subject and without 則 in main clause, and note 若...是 as in 若晉常先，是楚弱也 which has many parallels. Apodosis often )

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.7 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1734; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: nor fear a large one.

sense.def: stand in fear of; fear, be very much afraid of and at the same time in awe of

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.3.8 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1735; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1608; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: A superior man, in forming his plans,

sense.def: a person of superior character; the person of superior character 得見君子者斯可矣。

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.5.1 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1735; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1610; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: If we tender our submission early,

sense.def: in good time, at an early stage; at an earlier stage, at a sufficiently early stage

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.5.1 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1735; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1610; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: If we tender our submission early,

sense.def: surrender to, submit to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.5.2 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1736; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1611; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: and tried to bribe him by offering him a share in the government.

sense.def: bribe; bribe (e.g. yǐ 以 "with" precious objects, workers, or fine horses); give bribes to

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.5.2 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1736; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1611; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: He kept his mouth shut, however, and submitted to death.

sense.def: close (door so as to let no one in); lock up, bolt; close (mouth); shut (one's eyes)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.5.2 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1736; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1611; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: He kept his mouth shut, however, and submitted to death.

sense.def: mouth

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.5.3 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1736; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1611; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: "As I am able," rejoined Chaou-mang, "to submit to such a disgrace (from you),

sense.def: be able to endure or sustain (pain, adversity); put up with (objectionable persons)

tls:line.title: 春秋左傳(en)
tls:line.loc: Zuo Ai 27.5.3 (469 B.C.) Ya2ng Bo2ju4n 1736; Wa2ng Sho3uqia1n et al.1611; tr. Legge:861

tls:text.tls:line: "As I am able," rejoined Chaou-mang, "to submit to such a disgrace (from you),

sense.def: public disgrace, opprobium 雪恥 "wash away a public disgrace"
